subject: If we’re going to restore our Democracy, I need YOU
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mike Van Someren for WI
body:
I can’t do this alone

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/30e72d46754f/i-am-running-for-congress-8796782?e=356c0699dd)
https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=dcd38d4f35&e=356c0699dd
Folks,

The upcoming November election is going to be an uphill battle. Let’s be honest, the odds are not in our favor. But overcoming the odds is exactly what has shaped our country and created our democratic system of government. Time and again, America’s greatness has been realized when the chips were down and our backs were against the wall.

And now, with our democracy under constant and overwhelming threat, we can’t afford anything other than overcoming the odds — no matter how daunting that may seem.

I’m running for Congress because standing on the sidelines and watching our friends’ and neighbors’ rights fade and democracy crumble isn’t an option. I’m running to fight for the foundation of our country. I’m running because we deserve a representative who will put in the work of listening and helping solve problems faced by our country — not contribute even more to the extreme polarization that’s already paralyzed our government.

Scott Fitzgerald has been the opposite of all of those things. The 5th Congressional District — and Wisconsin as a whole — deserves better.

Can you chip in $100, $50, or even just $25 today to help us build the infrastructure and war-chest we’ll need to defeat Scott Fitzgerald? (https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=de42fd3b14&e=356c0699dd)
DONATE (https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=1de7cd9747&e=356c0699dd)
The odds may be against us, but I won’t let that stop me from advocating for the hard working Wisconsinites like you who just want our government to work again — and for our democracy to survive for our children and grandchildren.

I know that I’m not in this alone. Anything you can give today makes a difference and is appreciated immensely (https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=f409209ec4&e=356c0699dd) . As our country has proven time and again, there’s nothing we can’t accomplish when we come together united in a common cause, no matter what the odds may be.

Thank you so much for your continued support,

Forward,
Mike

Peter,

_Imagine this:_ You are traveling on a train, bound for the beautiful city of Paris on a vacation with your best friends. body:
Tomorrow marks the one year anniversary of the Biden-Harris Administration. | | | |
---
| | | Dear Friends,

One year ago tomorrow, President Joe Biden and Vice President Kamala Harris were sworn into office as the 46th White House administration. On the same day, Chair Jaime Harrison became the 55th Chair of the Democratic National Committee.

The President and Vice President took office during an unprecedented time amidst several crises. They promised to help working families, and they have done what Democrats do. They have delivered.

As the White House was delivering relief to households all across the country, Chair Jaime Harrison was holding our party together and leading us in the right direction.

Along the way, the President and Vice President have made a point to prioritize people of all identities, communities, and creeds, just as they did on the campaign trail. Equity is central to what we have accomplished as Democrats in just one year, and they continue to fight for the Democratic Coalition.

In this newsletter, we highlight the Administration's work over the past year and extend you a special invitation to an event with the President and Vice President tomorrow night. We hope to see you there!

Best,
Brencia Berry
Director of Coalitions and Community Engagement
Democratic National Committee

---
|
---
|
---
**Invitation: Live Grassroots Event with President Joe Biden, Vice President Kamala Harris, and DNC Chair Jaime Harrison**

Tomorrow night, join the President, Vice President, and the DNC in a reflection of the 46th Administration's first year in office. We'll discuss our successes, lessons learned, and what's ahead for Democrats. Register below:
| [RSVP](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=bbdc49b735&e=d6c5c7d7ec "RSVP")

| The Biden-Harris Administration has been in office for near 1 year. Here's a look back at all that they have achieved:
> * **Got Shots in Arms & Saved Lives:** The President set up a historic vaccination program that resulted in more than 200 million Americans fully vaccinated this year: almost 75% of all adults. Millions of teenagers and children are now vaccinated, and tens of millions of Americans are getting booster shots. The President closed the racial equity gap in COVID vaccinations among adults. And, about 96% of schools are open. All these steps have and continue to save countless lives.
> * **Got People Back to Work: **President Biden has grown the economy faster than in decades and added 6.4 million jobs - more in one year than ever on record. Recent weekly unemployment claims are down near a level not seen since 1969. Economic growth is the strongest in two generations – and for the first time in 20 years, the U.S. economy has grown faster than China’s.
> * **Passed Laws to Create Jobs & Rebuild Crumbling Infrastructure: **President Biden got the American Rescue Plan and the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law passed -- the most impactful legislative agenda for a first year President. The American Rescue Plan led to what experts estimate will be the lowest child poverty rate on record and the unemployment rate is down to 3.9% two years faster than projected. The Bipartisan Infrastructure Law will create jobs, provide clean drinking water, upgrade our roads, airports, and rail, and is a critical first step towards a clean energy future.
> * **Expanded Affordable Health Care: **President Biden increased the number of Americans with health care coverage to the highest number ever, and slashed premiums for millions – as a result of his actions, hundreds of thousands of Americans pay premiums as low as $10. He just banned surprise billing, an issue that has been particularly concerning to Americans in the past few years, and lowered the co-pays that many Americans pay.
> * **Restored America’s Global Leadership: **President Biden restored our global alliances and ended America’s longest war. For the first time in a generation, Americans are not deployed overseas in an ongoing war. The United States donated and delivered nearly 400 million vaccinations to developing countries – more than every other country in the world.
> * **Took Aggressive Action to Tackle the Climate Crisis: **President Biden rejoined the Paris Agreement and reestablished U.S. leadership at the global conference on climate change. He jumpstarted an electric future made in America, tripling production of electric vehicles in a year. He is deploying more wind and solar energy than ever before, addressing the long-lasting negative effects of legacy pollution and advancing environmental justice in undeserved communities, and creating good-paying, union jobs that are making our country stronger and more resilient to the changing climate.
> * **Addressed Gun Violence and Crime: **President Biden issued a comprehensive strategy to reduce gun crime, including cracking down on gun trafficking and the proliferation of “ghost guns.” The Department of Justice banned federal law enforcement from using choke holds and no-knock” entries. And, President Biden provided cities historic levels of funding through the American Rescue Plan to put more cops on the beat and invest in community programs that are proven to reduce crime and make our communities safer.
> * **Bolstered Domestic Manufacturing:** President Biden increased the competitiveness of the U.S. economy by finalizing the most significant changes to Buy American in almost 70 years. He directed federal dollars to U.S. manufacturers by creating the first-ever Made in America Office. Under his Made in America Executive Order, federal purchases will help to bolster domestic manufacturing and manufacturing supply chains, and support good-paying, union jobs.
> * **Confirmed Historic Judges: **More of President Biden’s lower-court judicial nominees were confirmed in his first year than any president since Kennedy – and the President appointed more Black women on the Court of Appeals than any President ever.
> * **Formed a Government That Looks Like America: **President Biden was the first president since Reagan to get all his initial picks for the statutory cabinet confirmed, and the first president ever to have a cabinet that truly looks like America: the first cabinet half female and majority non-white.
> * **Advanced Racial Equity: **President Biden signed a Day One Executive Order on advancing equity and racial justice and a separate Executive Order to expand Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility across the federal government. The Administration set a government-wide goal of increasing the share of federal contracts to small disadvantaged businesses, including those owned by people of color, by 50% by FY25, meaning an increase of $100 billion to these firms over 5 years. The Administration provided $32B specifically for Tribal communities and Native people in American Rescue Plan and $13B in direct investments in Tribal communities through the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law.
>
**In spite of unprecedented crises and opposition from Congressional Republicans, the President and Congressional Democrats got an enormous amount done for the American people in their first year. This is only the beginning for the Administration.**

Peter,

Never believe the Left’s narrative that America is a racist country; that the American dream doesn’t exist anymore; or that the Constitution is a relic of the past that disproportionately benefits Anglo Americans.

I’m speaking with authority on the matter: **I’m a first generation Haitian-American whose parents came to this country, quite literally penniless, to pick crops in South Florida during the 1980s**. Now, less than forty years after my parents experienced food insecurity and homelessness, I’m running for Congress – as a Republican. **I guess you could say that I don’t fit the Left’s definition of a conservative**.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=5c0120598824426e9952157471503583&_e=GWRWGCqouz9Kj6dwjfO83BDO7c7lACdXkXL3YkWYNkSUlTWwAeIm1YTVSK2Ajux4Sj-BQaVtAcfGnk7tJXUHxER7kOIhmbPclhBzZ4w8q8CPZ8xiRSXDsxQSIp3cvNfZtdxQEzu9SrP73olx0SCTeHj83wINBUbgU7xUhRyUdOqxHe0bReT-bQDtb5lqySOodjk4krnBa23uvjw44IMvgX91gHUiK0z8PB-QVkC3d0NW_BrdlBzas5NO3fuuOUNjGqlhJJjtNXIKCJAi8ljdAnnRGo1UVpSXRD4YN2Fji65QT1E7bsUn5jSxwdA8He7ru16Mdl9y_DDx-0gML5Z1jaCrme7dD4JGB6TY5duIyPOYvgfNtgsbUFzeNTmXTDQCiEgr1Jzeal6U8V2HI3c9jwB45TDcde3fa48V52p4wJ558oMw8M-ixGhZbbZCoBoitzsPGF9_DIsEN_WKu9Em1aQ64z0fYgK3IYpijiPXIkM%3D)

* I’m a military veteran (**I joined at 17**),
* I’m a lawyer (**I utilized the GI bill to pay for law school**)
* I’m a former Trump Administration appointee, having held various jobs during the four years President Trump held office.

**The thing I’m most proud about? My family built our own American Dream without the help of the government, or left-wing socialist politicians. And I’m running for Congress because some folks in DC just don’t understand that the government is not going to help make individuals successful – grit, determination and personal responsibility are keys to success.**

Every single day I thank god that I’m American. My family’s struggles are never far from mind, which is why when our current commander-in-chief uses **acid-laced words to describe the Republican Party** , it makes me only want to fight for what believe in that much more

**I’d love to know where else in the world, immigrants from one of the Earth’s poorest nations could rise from homelessness and become successful business owners in a matter of two decades. All the while, raising their children with such success that one of them decides to seek federal office. **

Rising from poverty in Haiti to the middle class in South Florida wasn’t quick or easy, but _**what is worth having in life that is easy?**_ I learned from my parents that hard work and grit – along with perseverance – pays dividends. Yet today, many Americans would rather depend on government handouts.

**I’m running for Congress because the folks in Washington have been there for too damn long. Creatures of Washington are responsible for the problems plaguing our nation today. Joe Biden is the prime example of what happens to good people when they become entrenched in Washington**.

Voter suppression is the Republicans' strategy to stay in power.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220119-2742-header&t=1&akid=2742%2E2526796%2EF0_-Yq)
Republicans will be forced to go on the record later today and cast their vote on the _John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act_.
Let’s be clear what their no vote means:
**This vote is an admission that the Republican party needs voter suppression to win elections.** Their election strategy is to keep Americans from voting and they’re perfectly fine making that known.
The fact that Republicans can lose the Senate and still block voting rights makes it even more clear that we must abolish the filibuster and elect a slate of new leaders who will fight for pro-democracy reforms.
[If you’re ready to help us grow our progressive caucus in 2022, will you split a $3 contribution between Courage to Change – AOC’s leadership PAC – and our campaign to help us support and elect progressive champions to Congress?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220119?refcode=em20220119-2742-P_FND_RES_LEG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=2742_2526796_F0_-Yq&akid=2742%2E2526796%2EF0_-Yq)

Let’s be clear: Voting rights are bigger than political ideology. They are the foundation of our democracy and our most core value to ensure that our government is ‘of the people, for the people, and by the people’.
When 19 states enact 33 laws to make it harder for Americans to vote, the natural response from legislators who believe in the values of democracy should be to pass voting rights protections.1 That is unless your party needs voter suppression to win.
Without voting rights legislation, it will be an uphill battle to reach voters, overcome heavily gerrymandered districts, and grow our majority this November.
**But with your support, we can get to work now supporting progressive candidates who will join our fight for comprehensive voting rights reform.**
[Alexandria is leading a new wave of progressive voices in Congress, and with our help, we can send more visionary leaders to join her. Let’s be clear what their no vote means: This vote is an admission that the Republican party needs voter suppression to win elections. Their election strategy is to keep Americans from voting and they’re perfectly fine making that known. The fact that Republicans can lose the Senate and still block voting rights makes it even more clear that we must abolish the filibuster and elect a slate of new leaders who will fight for pro-democracy reforms. Let’s be clear: Voting rights are bigger than political ideology. They are the foundation of our democracy and our most core value to ensure that our government is ‘of the people, for the people, and by the people’. When 19 states enact 33 laws to make it harder for Americans to vote, the natural response from legislators who believe in the values of democracy should be to pass voting rights protections.1 That is unless your party needs voter suppression to win. Without voting rights legislation, it will be an uphill battle to reach voters, overcome heavily gerrymandered districts, and grow our majority this November. But with your support, we can get to work now supporting progressive candidates who will join our fight for comprehensive voting rights reform. Thank you, Team AOC 1 - | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- Email us: mailto: us@ocasiocortez.com

body:
| [ ](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=BJAgHetUUIqrbBbKj3z09j9OpIZbBzc5g2-7VwfHf34&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=workforceshortage_1&n=1)
---
Friend -- In case you missed it, **Republicans are taking action to alleviate the Democrat-fueled workforce shortage that is hurting small businesses across the state.** **** According to [Empower Wisconsin](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=hzZHoe_LqjIxZeEPQX1TwHlGeovQPG49C1Iyy5JMdzbe_FiwjaJsJOUSzfxnyZKuvPekgYHWlNc6gF-QqM6UvKzOBukJH_1ybha1H_J0zgowSnLqYn_Jg-_rTYX5tJrd&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=workforceshortage_1&n=2): _Pledging to remove government-created barriers that have worsened Wisconsin’s worker shortage crisis, Republican lawmakers on Tuesday rolled out a package of bills aimed at getting the unemployed back to work.

__Dubbed the Stronger Workforce Initiative, the package would index unemployment benefits based on Wisconsin’s jobless rate, hold accountable unemployment recipients who refuse or fail to show up for job interviews, and tune up Gov. Tony Evers’ dysfunctional Department of Workforce Development that so miserably failed the unemployed during the pandemic.

__At a Capitol press conference, the authors of the bills said the “help wanted’ signs throughout the Badger State are hard to miss. Wisconsin employers say finding and retaining workers has been their No. 1 challenge in a worker shortage crisis that has gripped the state and the nation.

__State Senate President Chris Kapenga (R-Delafield) and Rep. Tyler August (R-Lake Geneva) in a joint press release said there’s an abundance of high-wage jobs and a large number of workers available. They say the Stronger Workforce Initiative will help remove government-created barrier between the two.”

_ _“Republicans feel an obligation to deliver smarter government programs that provide a safety net to the truly needy but don’t compete with businesses needing to hire those who are able to work,” the lawmakers said. “It is clear that the opportunities for Wisconsin’s workforce have changed, and our government systems need to change along with them.”_ While Wisconsin business owners have raised wages and improved benefits to attract more workers, “Help Wanted” signs are still widespread across the Badger State. **Republicans’ new bills are designed to get government out of the way and return Wisconsin’s economy to normalcy.** Meanwhile, Democrats have threatened to worsen the labor shortage with authoritarian vaccine mandates and policies that keep workers at home. Thankfully, small business owners have real advocates in Republicans. Read more from Empower Wisconsin [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=hzZHoe_LqjIxZeEPQX1TwHlGeovQPG49C1Iyy5JMdzbe_FiwjaJsJOUSzfxnyZKuvPekgYHWlNc6gF-QqM6UvKzOBukJH_1ybha1H_J0zgowSnLqYn_Jg-_rTYX5tJrd&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=workforceshortage_1&n=3). \- Team WisGOP

Harriet Hageman statement on Joe Biden's press conference
---
Wyoming Republican candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives, Harriet Hageman, today issued the following statement regarding President Joe Biden’s press conference:
“I had to laugh out loud when Joe Biden said he has ‘overperformed’ as president. It’s not possible for anyone to look at the smoldering wreckage of this administration and conclude that it has been anything but a catastrophe.

“Wyomingites are getting crushed by inflation, our energy independence is gone, the Supreme Court had to stop an unconstitutional vaccine mandate, our southern border may as well not exist any longer, the withdrawal from Afghanistan was a deadly disaster, and the president continues to divide Americans along racial lines. Not a person in Wyoming could look at this president and think he’s anything but incapable of doing his job.
“On top of it all, Biden called into question the legitimacy of the 2022 elections if Congress doesn’t pass his federal takeover of state elections, and also seemed to give Russia permission to invade Ukraine in a ‘minor incursion.’

“While Liz Cheney is serving as Nancy Pelosi’s hand-picked vice chair of the January 6th Committee, this is the atrocious record she’s helping Democrats distract attention from.
“Liz Cheney has chosen sides, and it’s not ours. Wyoming deserves a Representative who looks out for Wyoming.”

clean_body: | | | | Harriet Hageman statement on Joe Biden's press conference Wyoming Republican candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives, Harriet Hageman, today issued the following statement regarding President Joe Biden’s press conference: “I had to laugh out loud when Joe Biden said he has ‘overperformed’ as president. It’s not possible for anyone to look at the smoldering wreckage of this administration and conclude that it has been anything but a catastrophe. “Wyomingites are getting crushed by inflation, our energy independence is gone, the Supreme Court had to stop an unconstitutional vaccine mandate, our southern border may as well not exist any longer, the withdrawal from Afghanistan was a deadly disaster, and the president continues to divide Americans along racial lines. Not a person in Wyoming could look at this president and think he’s anything but incapable of doing his job. “On top of it all, Biden called into question the legitimacy of the 2022 elections if Congress doesn’t pass his federal takeover of state elections, and also seemed to give Russia permission to invade Ukraine in a ‘minor incursion.’ “While Liz Cheney is serving as Nancy Pelosi’s hand-picked vice chair of the January 6th Committee, this is the atrocious record she’s helping Democrats distract attention from. “Liz Cheney has chosen sides, and it’s not ours. Wyoming deserves a Representative who looks out for Wyoming.” | | | |

---

[We’re exhausted, and we’re asking for you to STAND with us, and tell Joe Manchin to do what’s right and abolish the filibuster »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/5194?t=6&akid=1144%2E878179%2Ews5Zip)

FROM: A Realistic Democrat
DATE: JANUARY 19th, 2022

**_Dear Senator Manchin,_**

We need to have a serious talk.

While I admire your desire for bipartisanship, in state houses across the country, **Republicans have been doing their best to dismantle voting rights.**

**And now, Senate Republicans have BLOCKED the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, which would protect voting rights at a national level!**

I’m enraged, Senator, so now, I’m personally DEMANDING you step up, meet this moment, and ABOLISH the filibuster and pass voting rights!

[That’s why I’m giving a donation of $2 to the Voter Protection Project, an organization founded to protect the right to vote, right now »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/5194?t=9&akid=1144%2E878179%2Ews5Zip) | [DONATE $2 TO SIGN THE LETTER!](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/5194?t=10&akid=1144%2E878179%2Ews5Zip)

_SIGNATURE PENDING DONATION OF ANY AMOUNT_
That isn’t all, Senator.

**In addition to trying to suppress voters, they’re trying to block every piece of legislation Joe Biden is trying to pass — putting the midterms at risk!**

The people of your state and our country deserve more. That’s why I’m imploring you to do the right thing and abolish the filibuster!

[So please, STAND UP, defend our right to vote and abolish the filibuster once and for all. I know I am, and I’ll show it with a $2 donation to VPP »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/5194?t=11&akid=1144%2E878179%2Ews5Zip)

Sincerely,

Join me and my running mate, Jim Renacci, for a **FREE viewing of the film I produced, “Unplanned.” Following the movie, based on a true story, we will lead a discussion and reflection on the film and what it means for the future of pro-life advocates and policies.** I will also share insightful behind-the-scenes stories of “Unplanned.”

body:
Insidious leftist ideology has taken hold of our educational system. It’s never been more important that we expose it, bec
| _Sponsored message_ |
---|---|---
Fellow Patriot, Insidious leftist ideology has taken hold of our educational system. It’s never been more important that we expose it, because the Left has lit an ideological fire, and that fire is now consuming the minds of young Americans, burning itself through the most aspects of American culture and politics. That’s why it’s of utmost importance that I hear back from you today. I’m no stranger to the authoritarian attitudes on campus; I famously felt the brunt of it when conservative students invited me to speak on the University of California, Berkeley campus. Radical leftist groups like Antifa vowed to riot and cause harm to others. [**HELP US FIGHT THE RADICAL LEFT**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z04f2r9c3f7ru9eap8t12tcoo33n36g0jdlus5go_rp22sh2s8i66ob2cdge0o33chh2bs) The fear of violence from leftist agitators was so great that:
* It cost $600,000 in security expenses and required hundreds of policemen to ensure that agitators didn’t disrupt or try to cause violence at my speech.
* The University shut down six buildings on campus during my speech and erected concrete barricades (YES, a wall) to secure the Berkeley campus.
* For the first time in 20 years, the City of Berkeley voted to allow the use of pepper spray against violent protesters.
* In the end, police arrested nine leftists for trying to sneak banned weapons into our event—with the likely intent to do harm.

It’s no longer just about the Left trying to suppress your conservative views on campus. It’s about using the threat of violence to silence the conservative values you and I share. [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zu3sld2vi004kk0vh4tqi9juc8u83ob1apsstrh0_rp22sh2s8i66ob2cdge0o33chh2bs) Meanwhile, schools roll out the red carpet for leftists like Angela Davis, Bill Ayers, Barack Obama, Bill Clinton, and Bernie Sanders. At Berkeley, taxpayer-funded school administrators tried to derail my event from even taking place. They told me that they didn’t have a lecture hall available, which was a lie. School administrators even cut the venue in half by not allowing students to sit in the balcony—a dirty tactic to minimize attendance. **The good news is the radical Left’s attempts to silence me completely backfired.****** More than 600 students showed up, and we were able to host an engaging and civil event. Then, OVER 10 MILLION PEOPLE watched my speech online (that’s more viewers than any of the major evening newscasts). This victory for the Conservative Movement would have never happened if it weren’t for the **Young America’s Foundation** **(YAF)**. When Berkeley tried to illegally block me from coming to campus, YAF sued the university —**and won.** But the radicals who rioted and tried to incite violence at Berkeley are relentless. Their stranglehold on America’s universities has not yet been broken. **Young America’s Foundation** has been an incredible partner in making sure I am able to share our conservative values with students on campuses across the country. In fact, I speak on campuses **_exclusively_** through YAF because I know YAF has the experience and leadership necessary to run the nation’s leading campus lecture program. Today YAF needs your help. **[Will you make a _TAX-DEDUCTIBLE_ contribution of $35 today to ensure that YAF can continue to present speakers, including Dr. Arthur Laffer, Katie Pavlich, Senator Ted Cruz, and many others to high school and college students? body:
As the Pastor of Sheridan.Church in Tulsa, OK, and a candidate for the US Senate in OK, I hear this question, often: "Should a Pastor run for politica

As the Pastor of [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=2996191.1940.1.cd2faee0b3a9ece31ff3530f9fbbc7c9) in Tulsa, OK, and a candidate for the [US Senate](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=2996191.1941.1.df0b5aed77ee49a8c924e5e5fc1cd1ed) in OK, I hear this question, often: "_Should a Pastor run for political office?_ " This question usually comes in the form of a statement from our _friends_ on the left who love the phrase... "**Separation of Church and State**." Unfortunately, the **education system in America has failed**. Most Americans have no foundation regarding the _GREAT_ history of our country, especially our Christian roots. There were roughly **250 Founding Fathers of America**. A Founding Father is someone who had a _substantial impact on the birth and establishment of America as a nation_ (Ex. 56 signers of the _Declaration of Independence_ , 55 delegates and 39 signers of the _US Constitution_ , 90 signers of the _Bill of Rights_ and etc...). Of the 250 Founding Fathers, approximately **95% were DEVOUT Christians**. Two of the _least_ religious Founding Fathers were **Benjamin Franklin** and **Thomas Jefferson**. It is interesting that Benjamin Franklin, who was one of the least religious Founding Fathers, wanted **the Bible to be taught in EVERY school in America**. Thomas Jefferson, whom our friends on the Left _adore_ , did write in a letter to a friend about the "**Separation of Church and State** " (this phrase was **NEVER** mentioned in **ANY** of our founding documents but **ONLY** in _a letter from Jefferson to a friend_). What was Jefferson talking about? During his time President, Thomas Jefferson allocated **taxpayer funds to support Christian missionaries to the Native Americans**. The US government gave money to Christian missionaries to evangelize the Native Americans. In 1800, Jefferson allowed the newly-built US Capitol building to host Sunday church services, which _he attended_ and had the US Military band lead in music. So much for Separation of Church and State for Jefferson... What was Jefferson meaning when he wrote to his friend in a letter with that _abused_ and _misused_ phrase, the "Left utilizes against people like myself?" Jefferson was not referring to the Church staying out of the affairs of the State but **rather the State staying out of the affairs of the Church**. This was the very reason that America was founded in the first place. The State in Europe had taken over the affairs in the Church and Christians fled to the New World for religious freedom. The Bible says, "_People perish for a lack of knowledge_." Americans have a tremendous lack of knowledge when it comes to our history, especially the role that Christian men and women played in building of America. Pastors were vital in the birth, establishment and success of our nation. America **was** a Christian nation. America **is** a Christian nation. America **will be** a Christian nation, Lord willing. I believe it is vital that Christians and even Pastors engage in the world we live in and help Save America because America is in _trouble_. Things seem hopeless for so many right now. Job 8:13 says, "Those that forget God have _no hope_." The reason America seems hopeless is because many have forgotten God. But... the reverse is true. Those who remember God have **HOPE**. **We need to remember our past and remember our God.** Thank you,

name: Abby Finkenauer
subject: Kyrsten Sinema and Joe Manchin are sellouts
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abby for Iowa Abby for Iowa
body:
I am shocked by the absolute absurdity ...
| | |
---
Peter: Late last night, Sens. Kyrsten Sinema and Joe Manchin joined with every Republican senator – including my opponent, Chuck Grassley – in opposing filibuster reform to pass critical voting rights legislation. To put it mildly, I have some thoughts on that.
I am shocked by the absolute absurdity of Sens. Sinema, Manchin and the entire GOP. They talk about the filibuster as if it's some tool of civility or compromise when the GOP is actively exploiting it to block legislation that would protect our most fundamental, cherished right – the right to vote.
**Let's be honest with ourselves here: The Senate is broken.** When I served in the House, I watched as countless bipartisan bills that would move our country forward died in McConnell's Senate time and time again. Now, Democrats technically have control, but two senators used their powers to join Republicans in obstructing policies that the vast majority of Americans support.
I won't mince words, I don't know what compelled Sens. Sinema and Manchin to serve in Congress, but I do know that they _refuse_ to do anything – anything at all – for working families like the one that I grew up in. **I don't know if they forgot where they came from or who they're there to fight for.**
**But I do know that I'm done with having our entire Democratic agenda rest in the hands of two people. It's time that we expand our Senate majority. **Now, with Sen. Grassley facing record-low approval ratings, we've got a real chance to do it right here in Iowa.
**Peter, you have my word: Send me to the Senate, and I will be the 50th vote we need to reform the filibuster.** I'll fight tooth and nail to protect voting rights, raise the federal minimum wage, and pass the PRO Act to strengthen workers' rights and our unions.
**I'm doing everything within my power to defeat Sen. Grassley and move our country forward, I just need you with me. [So please, can you donate $5 right now to defeat Sen. Grassley, expand our Senate majority, and pass critical legislation to move our country forward?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40859103/326292068/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk610-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3N2U4MWQyMi1mZTc5LWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PXcER_uIRXQER46quHgk5xyI5aXeopopMxlohyS50rw=)**
I know days like this can be frustrating and hard. So thank you so much for standing with me and fighting today.

– Abby

On Monday, we celebrated the life and legacy of Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.
Together, we called on Congress to expand voting rights, and we remembered the important message of an American hero who taught us that the arc of the moral universe is long, but it bends towards justice.
On the other hand, Marjorie Taylor Greene spent the day pushing baseless conspiracy theories comparing the horrors of segregation to simple vaccine requirements.
"I believe we are seeing a new segregation and discrimination beginning, wrongfully forced upon unvaccinated Americans by the tyrants of the Democrat Party."

Peter,

I’m appalled.

Last night, the Senate voted on -- and failed to pass -- legislation that combined two incredibly important voting rights bills -- the Freedom to Vote Act and the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act.

This shouldn’t even be an issue that is up for debate. **In Florida and across the country, voting rights are under assault in ways that affect all of us, while disproportionately impacting Black, Brown and poor voters.**

Yet somehow, the elected officials in our government don’t feel like our most fundamental ideals of our country are worth protecting.

But no matter what, I remain steadfast in my commitment to protecting voting rights and honoring the heroes who fought for this right. Some even lost their lives, and their fight will not have been in vain.

I believe we should make it easier -- not harder -- to vote so that underrepresented communities are included in our democracy. name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: We are taking on Big Tech, and need your help.
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59305062:JzgtydENv:m:1:3253819041:D4F4C44B1A514F78C826A47718783655:r) Dear Peter, I'm not going to beat around the bush, we are living in a dystopian, tyrannical state. My team at the Center for American Liberty has recently uncovered evidence of powerful elected politicians colluding with Big Tech corporations like Facebook and Twitter to de-platform and silence conservatives like you and me. **In other words, we've caught big government using tax-payer funding to silence their political opponents.** And if someone does not immediately stand up against this, the freedoms enshrined in our Constitution will become nothing more than meaningless words on a piece of paper. That's why we launched a lawsuit against Twitter, U.S. Senator Alex Padilla, and a handful of liberal elected officials for their state-sponsored plot to eliminate our First Amendment liberties, _and we need your help to win._ **[Will you join us in our lawsuit against Twitter and Sen. Padilla and help defend the First Amendment?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59305062:JzgtydENv:m:1:3253819041:D4F4C44B1A514F78C826A47718783655:r)** Let me explain. Like millions of Americans after the 2020 presidential election, conservative activist Rogan O'Handley took to Twitter to express his concerns about the dubious election procedures and skepticism of the results. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59305062:JzgtydENv:m:1:3253819041:D4F4C44B1A514F78C826A47718783655:r) [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59305062:JzgtydENv:m:1:3253819041:D4F4C44B1A514F78C826A47718783655:r) [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59305062:JzgtydENv:m:1:3253819041:D4F4C44B1A514F78C826A47718783655:r) Shortly after the election, many of Rogan's tweets were removed by Twitter and his account was permanently suspended for "violating the government's rules about election integrity." _Hopefully, I don't need to explain to you that censoring or de-platforming ANY American for their political beliefs or opinions is a gross violation of the First Amendment._ But it gets much worse. When Rogan tried to figure out why he was censored, he found that bureaucrats working for then-California Secretary of State, Alex Padilla, had explicitly instructed officials at Twitter to silence him. You see, Alex Padilla was being considered to fill Kamala Harris' vacated seat in the U.S. Senate, and he was afraid that Rogan's tweets would hurt his image and chances of being appointed. **So, the office of Alex Padilla immediately instructed his press secretary to contact Twitter and shut Rogan up.** **From:** California Secretary of State Communications Department **To:** Twitter **Date:** Tuesday, November 17th, 2020 at 12:31 PM Hi, We wanted to flag this Twitter post: [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59305062:JzgtydENv:m:1:3253819041:D4F4C44B1A514F78C826A47718783655:r) From user @DC_Draino. In this post user claims California of being a culprit of voter fraud, and ignores the fact that we do audit votes. This is a blatant disregard to how our voting process works and creates disinformation and distrust among the general public. Twitter then flagged the post as misinformation, deleted it, and -- a few weeks later -- permanently banned Rogan from the their site. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59305062:JzgtydENv:m:1:3253819041:D4F4C44B1A514F78C826A47718783655:r) That's why my team and I at the Center for America Liberty are suing Twitter, now-Senator Alex Padilla, California Secretary of State Shirly Weber, and a handful of other liberals for their involvement in this blatant assault on the First Amendment. But the only way we can take on the deep pockets and deep connections of these tyrants is with the help of patriotic Americans like you. [**Will you help us fund this critical lawsuit by sending a generous, tax-deductible contribution of just $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59305062:JzgtydENv:m:1:3253819041:D4F4C44B1A514F78C826A47718783655:r) My name is Harmeet Dhillon. Two years ago, I founded the Center for American Liberty with the purpose of protecting our First Amendment freedoms and civil liberties from being destroyed by today's left. We've taken on Governor Gavin Newsom in California when he unconstitutionally shut down small businesses, banned people from going to church, and kept millions of children locked up in their homes, out of school, during the pandemic. We've taken on Antifa for viciously assaulting and nearly killing journalist Ando Ngo who exposed Antifa's vile, anarchic plot to destroy the United States and turn it into a socialist utopia. **And now, we're taking on Twitter, Sen. Alex Padilla, and others for colluding to eliminate Rogan O'Handley's freedom of speech.** But as a non-profit organization, everything we do to defend our civil liberties is with the generous help of like-minded conservative patriots like you. And this massive lawsuit is expected to cost us over $1,000,000. _After all, we are taking a multi-billion-dollar company, the state of California, and a handful of well-connected politicians._ [**So, can I count on you to help us stand up to Twitter and Senator Alex Padilla by making a tax-deductible contribution of $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59305062:JzgtydENv:m:1:3253819041:D4F4C44B1A514F78C826A47718783655:r) I'm not exaggerating when I say that this is the legal battle that will define our generation, and the future of our country. Will we sit back and allow elitist politicians, billion-dollar corporations, and faceless government agencies to continue to trample our constitutional freedoms? Or will we prove that WE, the American people, are still in control of our own lives? [**Please join us in this critical fight to defend the First Amendment by contributing $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59305062:JzgtydENv:m:1:3253819041:D4F4C44B1A514F78C826A47718783655:r) Sincerely, Harmeet K. Dhillon P.S. For four years, leftist politicians and mainstream media figures would not let go of the bogus and unproven accusation that President Trump colluded with Russia to "steal" the 2016 election. But now that there is clear evidence that a California elected official colluded with big tech to censor conservatives who wanted to comment on the 2020 election those same leftists are dead-silent. I am absolutely fed up with left's hypocrisy, double-standards, and blatantly unconstitutional behavior. [**That's why I'm urgently asking you to contribute $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty to help us fund our lawsuit against Twitter and Senator Alex Padilla. **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59305062:JzgtydENv:m:1:3253819041:D4F4C44B1A514F78C826A47718783655:r) [**DONATE**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59305062:JzgtydENv:m:1:3253819041:D4F4C44B1A514F78C826A47718783655:r) [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59305062:JzgtydENv:m:1:3253819041:D4F4C44B1A514F78C826A47718783655:r) [Please consider supporting our efforts to defend our Constitution with a donation today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59305062:JzgtydENv:m:1:3253819041:D4F4C44B1A514F78C826A47718783655:r) The Center For American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization created to fight against growing anti-free-speech and anti-civil liberties trends.

Hey, Peter.
We’re really in it now! Our first critical campaign filing deadline is behind us and this movement to bring new leadership to Tennessee is picking up steam, thanks to supporters like you.
Right before the holidays, we wrapped our 95 Counties in 95 Days tour. From Mountain City to Memphis, we heard a call for new leadership and a demand to vote Bill Lee out. Here are just a few of the policy priorities we heard directly from the community:
* Expansion of Medicaid
* Updating Tennessee's antiquated marijuana laws
* Raising pay for our public school teachers
* Empowering our family farms
* Creating more green energy jobs
* Protecting our waterways from pollution

It's clearer than ever we need to defend the right to abortion nationwide.
#
Peter,
49 years ago this week, the Supreme Court made history in Roe v. Wade by affirming the constitutional right to abortion.
Unfortunately, that also means it’s been 49 years of extreme Republicans peddling misinformation, filling the judicial branch with anti-abortion judges and justices, and undermining the right to abortion through restrictive state laws.
We have a bill that would finally stop these harmful state-level bans on abortion that get in between women and their rights, and it’s past time we got it done.
**[Will you add your name now and call on the Senate to pass the Women’s Health Protection Act and protect Roe v. Wade? Supporters like you are crucial in the fight to defend the right to abortion.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40877511/326344196/1927915304?ms=pm_em_220120_1&refcode=pm_em_220120_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZDEyNjg4NC0xNjdhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YhknOzJxVWjmfSR3MsKHYL33PWs2dQNS3xGBg1uZYyo=&emci=ed1a87f7-0d7a-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=6d126884-167a-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=13116610)**
From Texas to Mississippi, 2021 saw attacks on reproductive rights like we’ve never seen before. And many states are already putting in place copycat laws inspired by Texas’ cruel, dangerous abortion ban that would allow strangers to sue anyone who helps someone get an abortion–whether it’s a doctor or a family member offering a ride.
It’s already become more difficult to get a safe and legal abortion since Roe. Nearly 90 percent of American counties are without a single abortion provider and many states only have one–forcing patients to drive long distances to get health care they need. As we approach the anniversary of Roe v. Wade, it’s _clearer than ever_ we need to defend the right to abortion nationwide.

Folks, Senate Republicans just exploited the filibuster to block critical voting rights legislation — yes, you read that correctly. **_Again._** The Democratic majority started the year with a comprehensive plan to protect and expand voting rights. It’s especially important now, as access to the ballot box is under threat across the country. Yet somehow, Republicans are the ones calling the shots on voting rights legislation, allowing voter suppression laws to go into effect across the country — all because we haven’t abolished the archaic filibuster. New year, same obstructionist tactics. **We have to choose — our democracy or the filibuster.** Last night, I chose our democracy. And I refuse to give up on passing legislation to expand the right to vote and make our campaign finance system more ethical. # Commonwealth Partners Endorses Bill McSwain for Governor
**West Chester, Pa.** **\--** Commonwealth Partners Chamber of Entrepreneurs, a membership organization representing employers and employees across the Commonwealth, today [announced](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=af3a4c2239&e=b1ec95759b) their official endorsement of Bill McSwain for Governor of Pennsylvania.

McSwain expressed his gratitude for the endorsement and emphasized his vision for a more prosperous Pennsylvania:
---
|
> _**"As a **_**_limited government, free market, law and order, constitutional conservative, _**_**I am grateful to receive the endorsement of Commonwealth Partners Chamber of Entrepreneurs. Together, driven by our shared priorities of a robust economy, public safety, school choice for all families, and a reinvigorated energy industry, we will work towards victory in November and a freer, safer, more prosperous Pennsylvania for years to come." **_
---
| These sentiments were echoed by Commonwealth Partners President and CEO Matt Brouillette:
---
|
> _**“Pennsylvanians are ready for a bold leader who will put their priorities first and fight to strengthen our economy, unleash businesses’ potential, restore local control, ensure every child has a chance at a great education, and take on the crime that’s plagued our cities for far too long. Bill McSwain knows what it means to lead, to fight, and to serve. Commonwealth Partners is pleased to endorse him for Pennsylvania governor." **_
---
|
More information about Commonwealth Partners Chamber of Entrepreneurs is [available here](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=bf1aa067c7&e=b1ec95759b).
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as US Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming an attorney, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=c5e283e692&e=b1ec95759b)

Peter,
I’m writing with some exciting news. Earlier this month, AB1400 passed the California Assembly Health committee. AB1400, or CalCare, is a bill that sets the policy framework for a single payer healthcare system in California. **Yes, you heard that right: California is one step closer to adopting a universal healthcare system for ALL residents, regardless of immigration status. **
**This was a huge win for the nurses and countless Medicare for All activists who have been championing CalCare for many years.** It sets the stage for a vote in the California Assembly, which if successful, would clear the way for California moving toward a healthcare system that would eliminate premiums, deductibles, and copays. **CalCare would be a dam break moment for Medicare for All in the United States,** as the US develops its very own single payer system that has worked so well in other countries around the world.
If California, the largest state in the United States, passes universal healthcare, other states will surely follow in our footsteps, setting the stage for Medicare for All to earn more support at the federal level in Congress. **More and more of us are championing the benefit that universal, single-payer healthcare coverage would offer.** Millions of Americans pay exorbitant premiums, co-pays, and prescription drug prices. Removing those would remove barriers for many of us, clearing the way for easier access to care.
**Too many people avoid getting the healthcare they need because they just can’t afford it. Medicare for All would change that.** It’s a no-brainer for those of us who have studied and witnessed the impacts of national healthcare in other countries across the world. We are not the norm; we are the outliers. We finally have a chance to change that.**I can feel that we are closer to passing universal healthcare than ever before.** I promise that when I get to Congress, I will be a constant advocate for what to me is the single most life-changing policy the United States could adopt.

STATEMENT OF GEOFF DIEHL REGARDING MAURA HEALEY JOINING RACE FOR GOVERNOR

BOSTON - Geoff Diehl, Republican candidate for Governor, issued the following statement today regarding Attorney General Maura Healey's announcement that she is running for Governor:--

"Exactly a year to the day after Joe Biden took office, Maura Healey has announced her campaign for Governor.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Honestly, we pretty much knew things were doomed as soon as we saw this.
#
It happened, Derek.
Last night, **Senators Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema doubled down on the filibuster, effectively killing Democrats' chances at passing the John Lewis Voting Rights Act and the Freedom to Vote Act.**
And they didn’t just *vote* with the GOP. Earlier, Joe Manchin even gave a speech on the Senate floor in front of a GIGANTIC pro-filibuster sign.
**I mean, just look at this thing...**
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/40899?refcode=ema20220120-4261&t=1&akid=4261%2E434096%2EJeGRFO)
So I fixed Senator Manchin’s sign.** From that ☝️ to this 👇
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/40899?refcode=ema20220120-4261&t=2&akid=4261%2E434096%2EJeGRFO)
In other words, Derek, **[send me to DC if you want THIS instead. Because I would PROUDLY vote to abolish the filibuster and actually get stuff done.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/40899?refcode=ema20220120-4261&t=3&akid=4261%2E434096%2EJeGRFO)**
If elected to the U.S. Senate, it is my promise to you that I will be the 51st vote Democrats need to finally abolish the filibuster and guarantee urgent legislation like the John Lewis Voting Rights Act. I just need your help to get there.
**[If you can, please send your first $5 our way ahead to support this fight to flip this seat for working people.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/40899?refcode=ema20220120-4261&t=4&akid=4261%2E434096%2EJeGRFO)**

Thank you, thank you, thank you. I am truly, truly grateful for all the support you've given our campaign so far.
John

body:
Looking back on some of my favorite memories from the campaign trail. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40881343/326356645/1820125544?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMWVkY2U1Zi0yMjdhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B6m4ltEZxII3U1u-EYwQdhapVml76mcXBp-ngL0tuUY=) Friend, 2021 is a year I will never forget.

In July, we launched my campaign to run for Congress, and since then, we’ve traveled the state connecting with community members in nearly every county—meeting with voters and talking about how we can bring real change to the place we all call home.

Whether we were marching in solidarity at the pride parade, or having coffee with union leaders and workers, I’m reminded of the grit and grace that’s in the hearts of every Montanan I meet. It motivates me to continue our work meeting voters where they are and fighting for the issues and challenges we all face.

Below are a few of my favorite memories from the past year. I hope you enjoy them. And if you have any questions or concerns, please respond to this email directly. Otherwise, I hope to see you on the road in 2022!

Best,

_Cora_ | **[Contribute »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40881344/326356646/655314317?refcode=em-1.20.22-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMWVkY2U1Zi0yMjdhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B6m4ltEZxII3U1u-EYwQdhapVml76mcXBp-ngL0tuUY=)**
---

* * *
**A huge 2021 highlight was celebrating the LGBTQ community at Helena’s Pride Parade in Anchor Park. It was so humbling to have the opportunity to deliver remarks on stage.**

subject: Whitmer and the defund the police crowd
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Michael Brown for Governor • P
body:
When Gretchen Whitmer had the audacity to say she ”supports the spirit” of the “defund the police” campaign she went too far. | | | |
---
| | | [ ](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=d5923953ff&e=0636b97700)
---
| Peter:

Our brave men and women of law enforcement have been under attack the past two years like never before.
* They’ve been targeted and harassed.
* The radical “defund the police” movement has cut funding for law enforcement in various cities throughout America.

* Liberal district attorneys and politicians have reclassified many crimes to be misdemeanors meaning criminals are being released and in many cases not even prosecuted for their crimes.
* Zero bail policies are being implemented turning criminals loose without any recourse.

**And what has been the result?**

_**Crime increasing everywhere.**_

I’m seeing it. You’re seeing it.

It must stop.

**When Gretchen Whitmer had the audacity to say she ”supports the spirit” of the “defund the police” campaign _she went too far_.**

Not only did she march in a large crowd during her own lock down order, but she raged into a bullhorn condemning the men and women in blue.
---
|
---
| Then, when a reporter made a statement that _had lockdown protestors been black they’d have been shot, Whitmer agreed_!

**Her contempt for law enforcement cannot stand.** It will take a new Governor to right the ship supporting law enforcement and reducing violent crime.

I’ve been on the streets of Michigan for 30 years taking down some of the worst criminals. Working in narcotics enforcement I can tell you, these aren’t nice people who only need a slap on the wrist.

Yet that’s what Gretchen Whitmer and liberal politicians like her are offering.

**They want to cut funding for law enforcement and redirect tax dollars into social programs.**

And the result is just what you’d expect – increasing crime.

It’s time to have a Governor in Michigan who will stand up for the safety of the people. Someone who will say enough is enough.

**Will you join me?** Together we can defeat Gretchen Whitmer and her liberal cronies. Together we can make our cities safe again – for all our citizens. Together we can fix Michigan.

Please take a moment today to make a generous contribution.

$5, $50, $500, or more.

Any amount helps.
---

---
| If you’re tired of hearing about increasing crime; if you’re tired of the witch hunt that is targeting the hard-working men and women who have sworn an oath to protect the safety and security of you and your family; if you’re ready for a change, then please stand with me.

[Join our campaign to Dump Whitmer and Fix Michigan.](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=6cf35ff394&e=0636b97700)

Please make a donation today, then head over to my website and volunteer to help. We need all hands on deck if we’re going to defeat her this November.

Thank you.

Michael Brown
Republican for Governor

name: Erika Benfield
subject: RELEASE: Erika Benfield Announces "Women for Erika" Coalition
body:
---
| | | | | |
---
|
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: January 20, 2022
---
| Contact: Derek Dufresne press@erikabenfieldforcongress.com; 202-809-6013
---
| Erika Benfield Announces "Women for Erika" Coalition
---
|
---
| Lake Mary, FL - Erika Benfield, candidate for Congress, announced the launch of the Women for Erika Coalition, backed by an extensive list of women all across Central Florida.
---
| Erika Benfield made the following statement in response to releasing her Women for Erika Coalition:
"I am proud to officially announce the launch of the Women for Erika Coalition. This group is full of strong, freedom-loving women who share the same conservative values that I will take with me to the House of Representatives.
"As conservatives, we don't care what false narratives the Left tries to push about women having no place in the Republican Party. We know that's just another lie that the liberal media have propagated. This group of women supports me not because of my gender but because they know that, when push comes to shove, I have the grit and toughness that's needed to get the job done. They know that when I win this race, I'm going to go up to Washington, D.C. and fight for America First values because that's what truly matters. When the socialists like AOC, Ilhan Omar, and Rashida Tlaib start targeting me for being a Republican woman, know that their hypocritical sexism will only fuel my fire.
"I'm honored to have this coalition of strong women in my corner, and I promise that I will fight to protect and preserve the God-given constitutional rights that we all cherish."
---
| The Women for Erika Coalition has released the following statements:
Jeanette M Stiles, DeBary FL "Erika is honest and is serious about helping people and veterans. She works hard and is trustworthy. I met Erika when I was canteen manager of VFW Post 8093, where she is an active auxiliary member."
Ashleigh Hart, Longwood, FL "I'm thrilled to hear Stephanie Murphy will not be seeking re-election. We have enough attorneys in Washington; we need to get back to BUSINESS. I've known and been friends with Erika for many years. She's a successful business owner, a former vice mayor of DeBary, and most importantly, a Mom. She knows what it takes to raise a family, build a business from the ground up, and run a city. She is loyal to the people, not the big donors. We need Erika Benfield."
Rachel Furrow, DeBary, FL "So proud to support not only the best candidate but a wonderful woman and friend for the U.S. House. A true Republican and defender of American rights! Erika Benfield, you are living the American dream with honesty and integrity."
Other members of the Women for Erika Coalition include:

* Cindy Wright, New Smyrna Beach, FL
* Carolyn Cook, Altamonte Springs, FL
* Emily Stiles, Team Erika Volunteer, Former Chairwoman Florida Southern College Republicans, Winter Springs, FL
* Nancy Bolduc, Deltona, FL

| Peter -
President Trump presided over the strongest economy in decades with pro-growth, small-government policies. His peace-through-strength approach kept America safe at home and abroad. Our border was secure and illegal immigrants weren't being released into our homeland. American energy independence was thriving and our oil and gas workers felt secure in their jobs. But all that changed a year ago today when Joe Biden stepped into the White House and Democrats took control of all the levers of government.

* Biden ended Trump's border-security policies, causing millions of illegal immigrants crossed our southern border and the worst border crisis in decades began to unfold.

* Biden assaulted our oil and gas industry, causing record high gas prices, America pipelines to be shut down, and millions of oil and gas jobs threatened.

* Biden imposed authoritarian vaccine mandates on the entire nation, causing Americans to lose their medical freedom and choose between their job or the vaccine.

Skyrocketing crime. Inflation. Empty grocery shelves. There is no aspect of American life which we can say is better today than it was one year ago, and it's all because of the policies implemented by Biden, Pelosi, Schumer, and the Democrats who stood behind them. But conservatives have an opportunity to correct all of this in November and get America back on track. As long as we are willing to fight for it.

clean_body: [] Peter , Yesterday Senate Republicans used the filibuster to block the John Lewis Voting Rights Act, legislation that would protect voting rights and safeguard our democracy. It was a disappointing result—especially for Texans whose voting rights have been under assault over the last year. But the fight isn’t over. We simply can’t afford to give up. When I’m elected, I’ll fight every day to pass legislation to expand, not limit, who can participate in our democracy. If you want a representative who will fight back against voter suppression and for voting rights, chip in to support our campaign. [] DONATE [] Peter , Republicans like Greg Abbott and Ted Cruz have weaponized Trump’s Big Lie to gerrymander, suppress, and subvert the votes of Texans. They’ve spread misinformation about fraud in our elections and used it to attack absentee voting and voter registration. Congress has no choice: they must pass federal legislation to protect voting rights and our democracy. Our campaign is working overtime to reach as many voters as possible, and making sure they are registered and mobilized to get involved. But with less than a month until early voting starts, we need all the help we can get. Can you pitch in to support our get out the vote efforts and help elect a candidate who will fight for voting rights in Congress? We can’t afford to sit-out this fight. [] Thank you for your support, -Greg [] [] [] Paid for by Greg Casar for Congress Greg Casar for Congress P.O. Fair Fight |

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40884402/326371769/1793776944?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzIwNmM4OS0yYjdhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KRcOI87IyfyZwApVMbs_1F_Fj47RmT6aC4WYOhLpKTU=&emci=cf26a0ba-217a-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=f7206c89-2b7a-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=1037277)

| | Dear Friend, In 2020 and 2021, voters turned out in record numbers to make their voices heard. In response, the nation witnessed Jim Crow 2.0. Just weeks after Georgia’s first Black and Jewish senators were sworn into office, state legislatures across the country began filing hundreds of anti-voting bills. Black people were removed from local boards of elections, and poll workers were forced to confront rising threats. But once again, we rose up. We came together to advocate for federal legislation to protect the freedom to vote for all eligible Americans. Working together, we made ourselves heard: the freedom to vote is essential to our country, and to this moment in our history. To say we are frustrated would be an understatement. We share that with you. **Last night, 52 U.S. Senators failed to uphold their duty as public servants by refusing to pass the Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act. ** Yet while Senators Manchin, Sinema, and their Republican colleagues have chosen to ignore the pleas of their constituents, it’s important you know this: **We have heard your demands, and we share them.** From Hot Call Summer through Freedom to Vote Fall, we made our voices loud and clear. And the 48 Senators who voted to change the rules heard us, too. You made it clear that we cannot tolerate barriers to voting for voters of color, veterans, voters with disabilities, rural voters, new Americans, or young people. That we cannot tolerate efforts to remove or harass local election officials. And you made it clear that **the freedom to vote is intrinsic to the issues that impact our daily lives.** For this reason, we will keep fighting. We are in this fight for the long haul, and we are in it with you by our sides. [**While we did not win last night, our resolve persists. We need you in this fight with us. **](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40884403/326371777/-2107014871?refcode=IE012022JLV&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzIwNmM4OS0yYjdhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KRcOI87IyfyZwApVMbs_1F_Fj47RmT6aC4WYOhLpKTU=) **Fair Fight Action will not waver.** We are committed to continuing our work on the front lines—along with local, state, and national allies—to protect the voice and vote of every eligible American. In just a few short months, voters across the country will cast their ballots in primary elections. These primaries will only serve as a small preview to the obstacles we’ll face in the November Midterms. **Ensuring that every eligible voter can register to vote, cast a ballot, and have that ballot counted fairly will be no small feat.** It will take all of us, working together, to fulfill the promise of our democracy. **Let us be clear: We will need you.** We will need poll workers, pro-democracy poll observers, volunteers to document peoples’ experiences with voter suppression, and folks working on the ground to get voters the resources they need. This is how we were able to support voters of color in 2020 and 2021 to ensure their voices were heard. And it’s how we plan to do so again in 2022. Fair Fight Action will be working around the clock to provide ways for you to join in this fight. History has already made clear that in moments like this, it is up to us to carry the fight forward. We have faced and overcome staggering odds before, and we are prepared to do so again in 2022. We will continue to do what we do best: advocate, organize, and mobilize. We will never stop fighting on behalf of voters everywhere. [**Join us.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40884404/326371811/-2107014871?refcode=IE012022JLV&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzIwNmM4OS0yYjdhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KRcOI87IyfyZwApVMbs_1F_Fj47RmT6aC4WYOhLpKTU=) Thank you, always, for your dedication and investment in our mission. — Team Fair Fight Action [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40884405/326371820/-2107014871?refcode=IE012022JLV&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzIwNmM4OS0yYjdhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KRcOI87IyfyZwApVMbs_1F_Fj47RmT6aC4WYOhLpKTU=) |

clean_body: Order your free tests online now | | | Dear Team, I would like to start by letting you know that the federal government is providing 4 free rapid Covid tests to every household. Let's work together to keep our communities safe. These tests are a start, but they are not enough. Our COVID strategy cannot be to write off the most vulnerable as expendable. We need a government that doesn't leave anyone behind, that doesn't believe any of us are expendable. We can start with universal access to testing, but the truth is, it should have started with addressing deep structural inequality long ago. We need our representatives at the federal level to be fighting for policies like universal childcare, extended unemployment benefits, and broadband to cover internet deserts like the West and Southside. Until we invest in long term solutions, we will continue to move from crisis to crisis, leaving people behind at every step. I cannot and will not accept a system that expects the most vulnerable to pay the price for the failures of our leaders. Let’s demand more. In Solidarity, Kina Collins | To give by check: Kina Collins for Congress 901 Lake Street, Unit 4093 Oak Park, IL 60301

| | | A bill introduced by Republican Senator Grassley, the American Innovation and Choice Online Act (S. 2992), is getting closer to a vote in the Senate. And it could be a HUGE mistake. We need antitrust laws, and we can’t let big tech run wild, but we need to make sure new laws help consumers and don’t hurt them. And the way this bill is written could have a severe impact on the convenience and quality of tech services consumers use every day. [Click here to tell your Senators to oppose S.2992 >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3996b1b6-5bc8-4651-93b0-b69d8f1d7895/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Effectively, this legislation could break Amazon Prime’s two-day shipping model and could stop Google from listing Google Maps and store reviews in search results. The bill could also remove iMessage, FaceTime, and Apple Music from being pre-downloaded apps on the iPhone, and much more. We need Congress to support antitrust enforcement that doesn't sacrifice the tools and innovations we all rely on. Team, The heart of our democracy is the right to vote, but last night, **not a single Republican Senator voted for a bill meant to defend and expand Americans’ voting rights.** _That’s pathetic._ Voting shouldn’t be a partisan issue, but over the years, the GOP has revealed they have no interest in making it easier for people to vote if it may result in more votes for Democrats. In fact, they’ve gone out of their way to make voting harder by purging voter rolls, passing restrictive voter ID laws, closing down polling places, limiting ballot drop-boxes, and drawing highly partisan district maps to make it easier for them to win elections. Pennsylvania’s GOP-majority state legislature has been at it for years. And yesterday, the **Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act** — which would help stop these attacks on voting rights by making Election Day a national holiday, establishing same-day voter registration in all 50 states, expanding vote-by-mail, and finally banning partisan gerrymandering — was blocked in the Senate by a 50-50 vote across party lines. As a combat veteran and as an American, this news is insulting and frankly, scary. We desperately need to stop the erosion of our voting rights and democracy at the hands of an increasingly extreme Republican Party, and we need more bold Democrats in office willing to do what it takes to make it happen. **My opponent Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick voted against this bill in the House. clean_body: | = Team, The heart of our democracy is the right to vote, but last night, not a single Republican Senator voted for a bill meant to defend and expand Americans’ voting rights. That’s pathetic. Voting shouldn’t be a partisan issue, but over the years, the GOP has revealed they have no interest in making it easier for people to vote if it may result in more votes for Democrats. In fact, they’ve gone out of their way to make voting harder by purging voter rolls, passing restrictive voter ID laws, closing down polling places, limiting ballot drop-boxes, and drawing highly partisan district maps to make it easier for them to win elections. Pennsylvania’s GOP-majority state legislature has been at it for years. And yesterday, the Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act — which would help stop these attacks on voting rights by making Election Day a national holiday, establishing same-day voter registration in all 50 states, expanding vote-by-mail, and finally banning partisan gerrymandering — was blocked in the Senate by a 50-50 vote across party lines. As a combat veteran and as an American, this news is insulting and frankly, scary. We desperately need to stop the erosion of our voting rights and democracy at the hands of an increasingly extreme Republican Party, and we need more bold Democrats in office willing to do what it takes to make it happen. My opponent Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick voted against this bill in the House. The Senate just voted against changing the rules that would allow Democrats to pass voting rights legislation. Everyone agrees that voting is a fundamental right that must be protected, but when it comes to legislative action,**the GOP has one goal: hold onto power at any cost.** The restriction of voting rights impacts Texans by making it one of the hardest states to vote in. The GOP trifecta in Texas has passed legislation in 2021 further restricting voting rights and making it even harder to vote. Right now, mail-in-ballot applications are being rejected because of this very legislation. That’s not all, County officials in Texas can limit the number of voting machines and polling locations to restrict the ability to vote, causing people to wait in line for hours, that’s unacceptable. **People who work hourly jobs don’t have the flexibility to take off 6 hrs in the middle of the day just to vote, or stand in line at the end of their day. They have children to pick up and families to take care of.** We must build consensus and pass voting rights legislation that:
* Ensures that voters have the ability to take off time so they can vote.
* Expands early voting and vote-by-mail.
* Allocates polling locations and voting machines based on population density so that wait times are not prohibitive to voting.

We need leaders in Congress that will successfully deliver on voting rights. Austin Texas, for the first time in decades, has the opportunity to send a new representative to represent our brand new district 37. **[Donna’s plan is simple: get every Democrat out to vote in Austin to help flip statewide races and take back Texas. Everyone agrees that voting is a fundamental right that must be protected, but when it comes to legislative action,the GOP has one goal: hold onto power at any cost. The restriction of voting rights impacts Texans by making it one of the hardest states to vote in. The GOP trifecta in Texas has passed legislation in 2021 further restricting voting rights and making it even harder to vote. Right now, mail-in-ballot applications are being rejected because of this very legislation. That’s not all, County officials in Texas can limit the number of voting machines and polling locations to restrict the ability to vote, causing people to wait in line for hours, that’s unacceptable. People who work hourly jobs don’t have the flexibility to take off 6 hrs in the middle of the day just to vote, or stand in line at the end of their day. They have children to pick up and families to take care of. We must build consensus and pass voting rights legislation that: Ensures that voters have the ability to take off time so they can vote. __
# MEET DERRICK GATES
__ Hello Friends, My name is Derrick Gates, Republican candidate for Congress in the now 36th District. Many people may not know yet, but the 33rd has now changed to 36th. While the district number has changed, the objective has not - to beat Ted Lieu. I would like to introduce myself to you and talk about why our campaign represents the best shot we have had to beat Lieu since he was first elected. I’m a husband, father, Christian, American patriot, small business owner, minister, and community leader. I am far from a perfect man - I have no hesitation admitting that. I tackled my flaws head-on, had an intimate run-in with Jesus Christ, and turned my life around. Since the moment I met Jesus, I have dedicated my life to the ministry where I counsel those who are
struggling, sit beside those who have lost their loved ones, help the less fortunate, and even kick down doors to physically pull people out of crack houses. My wife and I feed the hungry, house the homeless, turn former prisoners into productive members of society, and help the addicted get clean. We do all of these things while being forthright in our faith and belief in limited government, conservative principles, and pro-family values. We help our community, but we also defend the Constitutional rights of Americans, advocate for the unborn, fight for medical freedom, and are vocally supportive of the restoration of personal freedom and parental rights. My life experience and consistent defense of our shared values, combined with the political environment of this midterm election, provides us with a unique opportunity. Make no mistake about it - we can do what Republicans did in New Jersey and Virginia this past November. 2022 is undoubtedly going to be a wave year - so why not us? But I can’t win this race alone. We all know that campaigns are a costly endeavor, and with my family’s financial resources dedicated to our ministry, I need the help of patriots like you. Can you contribute $25, $50, $100, $250, or any amount you can afford today? To contribute, [click here](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/416378?id=12926.59.1.4f0e165ac80da0c40270fd7d0fe2910e). Together, we can show Los Angeles that America First means People First.
Thank you and God Bless, Derrick Gates P.S. If you would like to discuss my campaign, give me a call at 424-216-6893. Learn more about Derrick and see his endorsements so far below.
