| Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he's been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smearcampaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._iokuDw)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood's nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We're fighting back, but we'll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment - they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate $35 or more to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._35o5x-t8Yw3TNxTDLWN4A)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate $35, $50, $100, or more to stand with David Daleiden today.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You,Tom Brejcha

| I was just there talking election integrity – but more specifically the Constitutional Background for Decertification.

**You should know of a critical legal doctrine – that a right of action _cannot_ arise from a fraud.**

This has been true for as long as there is law – that fraud cannot be the foundation for action or the right of action. In other words, _no new rights are given as a result of something which is fundamentally and irredeemably fraudulent._

So, then the question becomes what do we do about it and who can do it?

Well, fortunately, the answer to this is pretty clear. If there is no legal right for Biden’s Presidency based on the above legal principle, the election must be decertified. This is obvious.

**_But who gets to do anything about this?_**

Well, this boils down to a key Constitutional distinction between enumerated powers and unenumerated powers:

An enumerated power is a power that is specifically given to the executive, and an unenumerated power is a power that is not mentioned in the Constitution – in other words it is specifically reserved for the people and for the Legislators.

**Let me break this down.**

**_If we have evidence that an election is _irredeemably_ _compromised_ , and there is no way to confidently declare a winner, then guess what?_**

**_You can’t declare a winner!_**

Don’t let the Democrats and the Fake News Media fool you. They want everyone to think that Election Integrity is a farce, is something made up by Conservatives who are mad that Joe Biden won.

_This is factually and demonstrably not the case. There is sound legal doctrine and Constitutional foundations for Election Integrity!_

**I demand that anyone who is attacking the Election Integrity Movement come with Constitutional facts, not false accusations.**

And the solution is simple folks:
1. First, have paper ballots that are hand counted
2. Don’t be solely reliant on electronic tabulation.
3. Secure these ballots by having a clear audit trail and currency-grade watermarking.

**It’s amazing how simple the solution is. But right now we are fighting huge money from the Democrats going to fight Election Integrity, smear our campaign and the movement, and getting the media to SILENCE us.**

[_This is why I need your help. We are pushing to have these currency grade ballots adopted not only in Arizona, but around the Country. And to do this, we need your help!_

_Please donate generously today to help the cause, push forward Election Integrity, and make sure that I am elected to Secretary of State of Arizona, where I will make sure we are the Golden standard of Election Integrity!_](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=4022b537ef&e=44b8c466b0)

| | Three hundred and sixty five days ago, Joe Biden and Kamala Harris raised their right hands and were sworn into office. It was a big, bright, hopeful day that arrived just two weeks after one of the darkest days in American history. After some of the recent setbacks in the US Senate, it is easy to be frustrated. I am frustrated, too. But let us take a moment and review what has happened in just one year of the Biden Administration.
* More jobs have been created – 6.4 million – than in any year in American history.

* Child poverty is at its lowest level ever, thanks to our recovery package.

* Over 200 million Americans are fully vaccinated against COVID, 75% of all adults.

* 5 million more Americans have health insurance — in the middle of a pandemic!

Finally, as you know, we passed **an historic infrastructure plan** that is a big, bold investment for the long-term future of our nation's roads, bridges, airports, and ports. We are **fighting climate change** , with a national network of 500,000 electric vehicle chargers, upgrades to our electric grid to make it ready for green energy, a major expansion of passenger rail service, and investments in zero- and low-emission buses and ferries. **And we are doing it all by putting hundreds of thousands of people to work in high-paying, union jobs.** We have a lot of work to do. And the setbacks are real. But here is what I know: We should be proud of what we have been able to do together. And we cannot go back. **We cannot let the Republicans take control of the House and Senate. And we cannot let them take back the White House in 2024.** We have work to do. clean_body: | | | Three hundred and sixty five days ago, Joe Biden and Kamala Harris raised their right hands and were sworn into office. It was a big, bright, hopeful day that arrived just two weeks after one of the darkest days in American history. After some of the recent setbacks in the US Senate, it is easy to be frustrated. I am frustrated, too. But let us take a moment and review what has happened in just one year of the Biden Administration. More jobs have been created – 6.4 million – than in any year in American history. Child poverty is at its lowest level ever, thanks to our recovery package. Over 200 million Americans are fully vaccinated against COVID, 75% of all adults. 5 million more Americans have health insurance — in the middle of a pandemic! Finally, as you know, we passed an historic infrastructure plan that is a big, bold investment for the long-term future of our nation's roads, bridges, airports, and ports. We are fighting climate change , with a national network of 500,000 electric vehicle chargers, upgrades to our electric grid to make it ready for green energy, a major expansion of passenger rail service, and investments in zero- and low-emission buses and ferries. And we are doing it all by putting hundreds of thousands of people to work in high-paying, union jobs. We have a lot of work to do. And the setbacks are real. But here is what I know: We should be proud of what we have been able to do together. And we cannot go back. We cannot let the Republicans take control of the House and Senate. And we cannot let them take back the White House in 2024. We have work to do. And I am counting on you to help. **Matt Jacobs Announces National and Local Endorsements** GOP Leader Kevin McCarthy Tops List of Conservative Leaders Endorsing Thousand Oaks, CA – The campaign of federal prosecutor Matt Jacobs today released its first round of high-profile endorsements showing Matt Jacobs with the clear momentum and support to win California’s 26th Congressional District. House GOP Leader Kevin McCarthy’s endorsement, along with many members of the California Congressional Delegation, proves Jacobs has the broad support needed to raise money and build a winning coalition. “Matt Jacobs is a proven public servant. As a federal prosecutor, Matt investigated and prosecuted America’s enemies. He won high-profile cases against terrorists and opioid traffickers, upholding the rule of law and protecting our neighborhoods and communities. We need proven public servants in Congress, and that’s why I’m proud to join many Members of our Congressional Delegation and endorse Matt Jacobs for Congress,” said Leader McCarthy. “Matt will help us Take Back the House, Fire Pelosi and end the Democrats’ One Party Rule of our federal government.” “Single-party rule has been disastrous for California – and the far left is now taking our country down a similar path. I’ll stand up to their extreme agenda, pursue commonsense solutions to the many problems we face, and fight to make sure that everyone has the freedom and opportunity to make their American Dream a reality,” said Jacobs. “I thank Leader McCarthy for his support and endorsement and I look forward to helping make him Speaker McCarthy in 2023 when we take back the House.” Matt Jacobs’ endorsement announcement comes on the heels of a record-breaking fundraising year, in which the campaign raised $850,000 from over 1,500 individual donors, with more than $650,000 cash on hand. Jacobs has raised more money at this point in the cycle than any challenger ever in the 26th Congressional District. Jacobs also noted how extremely proud he is to roll out a list of influential local leaders alongside national ones such as Leader McCarthy. Of note, the Ventura County Deputy Sheriffs’ Association and the Ventura County Professional Peace Officers’ Association have both endorsed Matt Jacobs for Congress. “Our grassroots network is incredibly strong here in the 26th, and I’m thrilled to have an organized and energized local base of supporters – including many members of our law enforcement community – who are willing to put their names on the line for us,” Jacobs said. clean_body: Peter, I am running in this race to be a voice forthe hardworking families of Pennsylvania , an advocate for real solutions, and a fierce defender of our shared rights and freedoms. Unfortunately Peter, the Democrats in Congress have lost connection with the real issues the American people are facing. It's clear from the Democrats voting rights alarmism, threat to end the legislative filibuster, and the continued calls to defund the police that the leadership in Congress needs to change now.** We need to start solving the REAL problems our nation faces, not create and manufacture more. It’s as important to me as it is to you that America starts to see improvement from the many challenges we are facing since the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic. I believe I can help bring better opportunities, better education, and better security to the American people. BETTER Opportunities:** As a business leader, I understand the economy and how to make it work for everyone. I will fight to ensure that every American has the same opportunity for success. It is my goal to bring manufacturing back to the US while expanding our market for knowledge workers. BETTER Education: As a former school board president, I know the importance of education to the entire community. I will fight to ensure that our children are always able to attend school in person. I believe parents should always have a choice in their children’s education. BETTER Security: I will make sure Internet economy works to our advantage and does not try to productize us. I will fight to ensure that Big Tech and foreign adversaries are held accountable for their actions. If we work together, we can make this possible. Peter, donate today and join me in the fight to better our education, opportunities, and security. Thank you, Christian Nascimento** | | | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by The Friends of Christian Nascimento

Friend – **I am so excited to be reaching out to you on behalf of my son, Marco Lopez, who's running for governor of Arizona.**
Fifty years ago, Marco's dad and I made the decision to move our family from Mexico to Arizona. We came here for the promise of greater opportunity – for the promise of Arizona. But I never could have imagined where that promise would take Marco.
**From becoming the mayor of our hometown of Nogales, Arizona, to serving in the Obama administration, Marco has always been a champion for the people of this state. And today, he's following in my footsteps – running his own small business, creating jobs and opportunity in his community. **

As a mother, I couldn't be more proud of Marco – and as an Arizonan, I couldn't be more excited for the vision he has for our great state. From defending voting rights to fixing our broken education system to increasing access to affordable health care, Marco is dedicated to making Arizona a state that works for _all_ people.
**But it won't be easy. He's running against a Trump-backed Republican – and she cares more about pushing her extremist agenda than fixing the problems of our state. Simply put, she's the exact _opposite_ of my son.**

name: Tom Fitton
subject: Our work is exploding!
body:
Already, this early into the New Year – Judicial Watch’s work is exploding in volume and growing in historic importance.

| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

Already, this early into the New Year - Judicial Watch's work is _exploding in_ _volume and growing in historic importance_.
That's why I ask that you consider [supporting us with a special tax-deductible gift today. ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57694&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
_In just the past few weeks_ ...
* We filed a federal civil rights lawsuit on behalf of Kari McRae, a Massachusetts high school teacher who was _fired in retaliation for posts on social media objecting to the inclusion of Critical Race Theory (CRT) in schools_. They targeted and fired her for exercising her First Amendment rights to criticize CRT...but we will not let them trample her civil rights. _This_ _is the third federal civil rights lawsuit Judicial Watch has filed in the last 12 months on behalf of teachers fired for expressing conservative views_!

* We filed "warning notices" against 14 counties and five states - Arkansas, California, Illinois, New York and Oregon - that _we will sue them_ for evident violations of the voter roll cleaning provisions of the National Voter Registration Act, if not promptly corrected. Judicial Watch continues to lead the charge for clean voter rolls and election integrity!

* And just last week, **__we won a huge court victory__** in Asheville, North Carolina, which _, thanks to a Judicial Watch lawsuit_ , ended its indefensible race-based scholarship program that excluded non-black students. It is illegal to discriminate on the basis of race. _Period_.

Our need to monitor and police our government officials never ends...corrupt politicians and secretive government bureaucrats cannot police themselves! And no one is working harder than _your_ Judicial Watch to challenge this culture of corruption.
And we can do this essential work because... _and only because_ ...of the generous support we receive from our supporters. [With your help](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57694&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=), we don't let corrupt politicians like Joe Biden off the hook just because they won an election.
_Nor do we let Deep State officials escape accountability for undermining our Constitution and keeping citizens in the dark about what government is doing_! When they refuse to comply with our open records laws or violate other statutes, we challenge them in the courts. And since Congress has proven untrustworthy in its oversight role, we fully intend to conduct more investigations and filing more lawsuits in 2022.
Indeed, we have a lot of hard work ahead this year...
We are also leading the way challenging illegal state and local sanctuary policies that cripple immigration law enforcement...including our historic lawsuit challenging the _deadly_ sanctuary policy in Santa Clara County, California (San Jose).
_And Judicial Watch 's work in the courts supporting law enforcement against illegal immigration has never been more urgent_. Joe Biden is the most radical open-borders president in our history, and the crisis on our southern border prove it.
**On this and so many legal fronts,_your Judicial Watch is virtually the
_ _only game in town_! ****Judicial Watch 's independent watchdog work leaves **
**Congress and Big Leftist Media in the dust ...and _we prove that every day_!**
But these battles are expensive...
...and we don't have the deep pockets of the government to fund our independent investigations, litigation and public education...instead, we rely on you and other conservative Americans who share our commitment to upholding the rule of law.
That's why I am counting on you to [help us with a tax-deductible contribution at this time.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57694&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=) _With your support our work can literally change the course of history_.
Sincerely,
Tom Fitton President

**I wanted you to be among the first to know that we’ve now raised over $1M in our campaign to flip Oregon’s 4th Congressional DISTRICT RED** The more we meet with voters across the district, the more confident I am that 2022 is going to be our year.

And while I’m thankful for all of the support that has come in from my fellow Oregonians, _**I’m particularly thankful for those who call another state home and decided to support me anyway**_!

Amanda Makki will be the keynote speaker this Saturday at the Second Annual Tampa Bay March for Life! The sanctity of life is a cause Amanda is passionate about and we would love to have you march with us on the 49th anniversary of Roe vs. Wade.

**Saturday, January 22nd
9:15-11 a.m.
Meet at 33 6th St. South in St. Petersburg at 8:30 a.m.
March will start at 9:15 and end at City Hall.**

Amanda stands with Governor Ron DeSantis who believes in strengthening protections for the unborn. She also fully supports the Hyde Amendment to keep our taxpayer dollars from being used to pay for abortion services. This is an important event in Tampa Bay and we hope you'll join us to show your support.

See you on Saturday!

Team Makki

body:
what it takes to win
| | |
---
**Listen up, friend!**
Congresswoman Val Demings is down 2 points in her race to defeat Marco Rubio. It's one of the hottest Senate races in the country – and I have zero doubt in my mind that Val Demings can win this. But Val Demings can ONLY win if activists like YOU dig deep and support her every step of the way.
So here's what I'm dropping in to tell you: Flipping Florida blue can decide our Democratic Senate majority. And CNN is calling Florida's Senate seat one of the most likely to flip in November – but Florida's last Senate race was decided by just 0.12 percent (that's only 10,033 votes).
That's why moments like this can make or break a campaign. That's especially true when I'm up against a right-wing incumbent like Marco Rubio, who is already sitting on a multimillion-dollar war chest and has the full GOP establishment behind him. **So I committed to helping Val Demings raise $55,000 before her midnight deadline tonight, and I'm counting on your contribution to get us there, friend: **
**[Will you rush $5 or more now to help Val Demings defeat Marco Rubio, flip Florida blue and expand our Democratic Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40887467/326385843/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2190-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjM2ZlODhkMS0zODdhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=D_YbSexYk5v4OskLhCN-7WAVjuCmRjGdmQl0v74kRKM=)**
From the White House to the campaign trail, I've seen it all. More than most. I've seen what it takes to win, and I've seen what happens when campaigns fail to muster enough grassroots momentum. I'm told Val Demings has one of the strongest grassroots teams in Democratic politics – and trust me, I was relieved to hear it.
Because you know what we're up against, friend? Marco Rubio's campaign war chest. Mitch McConnell's super PAC that can spend near limitless sums of money. And you'd better believe Donald Trump – who has made Florida the de facto HQ for the GOP – will rally his base and spend millions to protect his crony, Rubio.
That's why we need Val Demings. She's gone toe-to-toe with some of the most extreme Republicans. She impeached Donald Trump and prosecuted him in the Senate. body:
No matter how many times the Senate considers voting rights proposals, the outcome will NOT change until we end the filibuster.
#
Peter, Republicans in the Senate just filibustered urgently needed legislation to protect the right to vote across America. Again.
And when Senate Democrats tried to bypass the filibuster, they were unable to get all 50 Democratic Senators on board so they could pass critical legislation to save our democracy.
No matter how many times the Senate considers voting rights proposals, the outcome will NOT change until we do something about it. Republicans are leading the charge on voter suppression, so why would they suddenly join us to protect voting rights? We can’t wait for them; we have to act on our own.
**We need to end the filibuster and protect our democracy.**
[**Peter, are you with me? Join us in this fight to end the Jim Crow filibuster by chipping in an urgent donation of $3 or more right now. Voting rights and our democracy are on the line.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/9858?refcode=em20220120-971&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=971%2E420207%2EJm_lXH)
**[Chip in $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/9858?refcode=em20220120-971&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=971%2E420207%2EJm_lXH)**
It’s critical that Senate Democrats immediately bypass the filibuster and pass legislation to protect voting rights, free and fair elections, and our democracy.
Republicans will always prioritize voter suppression and attacks on our democracy. And with the filibuster in place, our Democratic majority that voters delivered us won’t be able to pass the critical reforms needed at this moment — like getting big money out of politics, LGBTQIA+ protections, gun violence prevention measures, climate justice, reproductive rights, and more.
We can’t afford to squander our best opportunity to pass legislation that ensures people can exercise their right to vote. We can’t afford to squander our best opportunity to deliver for the people. Ending the filibuster is how we safeguard our elections against the GOP’s dangerous, anti-democratic attacks. There’s just too much on the line for the Senate to continue delaying legislation that is critical for our democracy.
[**Contribute $3 or anything you can today so we can redouble our advocacy for immediate action in the Senate to bypass the filibuster and protect the right to vote.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/9858?refcode=em20220120-971&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=971%2E420207%2EJm_lXH)
In solidarity,
Pramila

| Friend,

Big Tech Giants in Silicon Valley are stripping their political enemies of their First Amendment Rights. What started with censorship and shadow banning conservative commentators and pundits, came to an alarming new standard when they banned President Donald J. Trump.

Seeing the sitting President of the United States deplatformed was shocking to all of us, but the big tech giants weren’t done there. Remember, if they can do it to a sitting United States President, they can, and will, do it to you.

Just this past month, a Republican U.S. Representative from right here in Georgia was banned from Twitter. Dr. Robert Malone, who played a large role in the invention of mRNA technology that created the COVID-19 vaccine, was also banned from Twitter. This is not the country that the Founders envisioned–a country where truth is in the eye of the powerful and all dissenting voices are silenced. We must protect the First Amendment and that starts with Repealing Section 230! [If you are ready to take on Big Tech, Join me today!](https://davidcurryforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=852ebb75cc52ccc1113c21207&id=4277ca1660&e=598f6aa24c) Big Tech and the Radical Democrats want to silence YOU. body:
| Peter -- There’s something very important that conservative Minnesotans need to understand: If we choose the same failed career politicians to face off against Walz this November, we will lose to the radical left **again**. The left has grown far too comfortable in this state, challenged only by weak Republicans that resort to abandoning their principles to get elected. In a desperate attempt to hold onto their positions, they govern so timidly that most of the time you can’t even tell they’re Republicans! **Conservatives cannot afford to make these same mistakes any longer.** I am running to kick the radical leftists and career politicians out of their ivory tower, and fight hard to take back the liberties they have stolen from us. This movement to save our state will not be successful without your help. If you value liberty, if you’re sick of what Tim Walz and Joe Biden have done to Minnesota and this great country, then I need you to go to caucus on February 1st. **Going to caucus, signing up to be a delegate, and voting to endorse our campaign for a free Minnesota is the single most important thing we can do to get a CONSERVATIVE in the governor’s office next year, and take back our state!** If grassroots conservatives don’t take action Right Now, Tyrant Tim Walz will glide into a second term and continue destroying the state we want to keep calling home. | Go To Caucus - Be A Delegate

body:
A quick reminder while our rights are on the line
# [](https://act.morganharper.org/go/1512?refcode=em20220120-526-footer-ak&t=2&akid=526%2E90090%2Ej9pr7Q)
**Last night, the Senate failed to pass critical voting rights legislation.** 52 Senators joined together to protect the archaic and racist filibuster rule, which requires a supermajority to end debate – effectively killing the bill.
A quick reminder: **There are no Black women in the Senate.** And the 48 senators who stood together to try to protect voting rights _represent 34 million more people_ than the 52 who stood opposed.
It’s clear that right now, the Senate is broken.
**[We can change that by electing an unbought, principled progressive to represent Ohio instead of yet another self-serving, moderate politician. If you’re with me, rush a contribution of any amount right now to help fuel our campaign.](https://act.morganharper.org/go/21422?t=3&akid=526%2E90090%2Ej9pr7Q)**
**[Contribute $5](https://act.morganharper.org/go/21428?refcode=em20220120-526&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=526%2E90090%2Ej9pr7Q)**
We know how high these stakes are, and we can’t risk another Senator Manchin or Senator Sinema when our civil rights are on the line. **You can be certain that I’ll be a YES on getting rid of the Jim Crow filibuster rule to protect our right to vote.**
That’s why I’m running — and thank you for being on our side.
Together,
Morgan Harper

#

Mark Kelly took a stand on voting rights yesterday.
In the face of unprecedented attacks on Arizonans’ right to vote, Mark supported carving out an exception to the filibuster to pass legislation that will defend this right for all Americans.
Mark took this step because voting is one of the most important rights we have as Americans, and that right has been under attack for decades.

Harriet Hageman statement on Joe Biden's first year in office
---
Wyoming Republican candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives, Harriet Hageman, today issued the following statement regarding President Joe Biden’s 1-year anniversary as president:

“We knew Joe Biden would be a terrible president for Wyoming, but I don’t know if anyone thought he would be this bad.

“Inflation is rising out of control, our energy independence is a thing of the past, our southern border with Mexico has been wiped away, the Afghanistan withdrawal cost 13 American lives and left the Taliban in possession of American military equipment, and the COVID pandemic is worse than it has ever been. Joe Biden is ruining this country and our allies have no faith in American leadership on the world stage.

“Through it all, we would expect that our representative in Washington, D.C., Liz Cheney, would be fighting tooth and nail against the disastrous Biden administration, but she is not. She spends every ounce of her energy fighting her personal war with President Donald Trump, aiding the Democrats in their scheme to divert attention away from the smoking wreckage of Biden’s presidency.

“Wyoming deserves a member of Congress who actually looks out for Wyoming. When I’m in Congress, that’s exactly what I’ll do.”

subject: Jack Johnson’s Gerrymandering Lie
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/redistrictingfund [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/redistrictingfund]

Peter,

This morning, the GOP Senate supermajority rammed their district maps through their chamber. These maps are dangerous — they dilute minority voices and rip our communities apart, all so they can keep their unchecked power at the state legislature for another decade. Senator Jeff Yarbro (D - Nashville) even asked the Senate Majority Leader, Jack Johnson (R - Franklin), if the goal in drawing this map was to eliminate the prospects of a Democratic Congressman from representing Middle Tennessee, to which Johnson brazenly replied “NO.”

Jack Johnson’s lie couldn’t have been more blatant. Nashville and so many other communities across Tennessee were needlessly ripped apart for Republicans’ political gain.

We are preparing to sue the Tennessee Republican Party for their racially gerrymandered maps, but we need your help — can you chip in $25 now to help us meet our goal of raising $30,000 this month for our legal fund so we can effectively mount a lawsuit against them? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/redistrictingfund]

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

The Republicans’ rigged maps will stifle progress here in Tennessee for another decade. We have made so much progress, but it’s difficult to see our gains with the deck so viciously stacked against us. If we want to flip districts and start building back blue, we need to successfully sue TNGOP for their rigged maps.

Can we count on you to help us meet our goal? We’re so close — chip in $25 now to help us get there! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/redistrictingfund]

name: Alexandra Rojas
subject: Henry Cuellar's home raided by FBI agents
body:
We just learned that the FBI raided Henry Cuellar’s house.
#
Peter,
Local reporters in Texas just broke the news that FBI agents raided Rep. Henry Cuellar’s house and campaign office, collecting and carrying out evidence.
[](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/89492?refcode=em20220120-21578&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=21578%2E1203867%2Ec87YnP)
Peter, we don’t know much about the FBI raid yet. But it can’t be good news for Henry Cuellar’s campaign.
Two days ago, things were looking very good for Cuellar’s reelection. He reported having $2.3 million in corporate-backed campaign cash — far more than Jessica Cisneros, who isn’t taking a dime of corporate PAC money.
Honestly, we were worried that we might get outspent badly and lose this race.
**Now, the race is blown wide open.** With this news on the FBI raid, we have an opportunity to get voters to reconsider Cuellar before they start casting ballots in just four weeks.
**There is a very good chance that Jessica Cisneros can win this race _if_ we see a huge surge in fundraising for her campaign right now.**
[Rush a $3 contribution straight to Jessica Cisneros right now to help her seal the deal. Your contribution today could mean the difference between victory and defeat.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/89492?refcode=em20220120-21578&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=21578%2E1203867%2Ec87YnP)
**[Contribute $3](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/89492?refcode=em20220120-21578&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=21578%2E1203867%2Ec87YnP)**
Last time, Jessica lost by only 2,746 votes — just 3%. This time, we can seal the deal and elect another fighter for working families to the U.S. House. But it’s going to take an enormous surge in these next few weeks to make it happen.
We’ll keep you updated when we know more on the FBI raid and investigation. For now, the most important thing you can do is [donate to Jessica’s campaign to give her the resources she needs to reach as many voters as possible.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/89492?refcode=em20220120-21578&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=21578%2E1203867%2Ec87YnP)
Thanks for everything you do for our Justice Democrats slate, Peter.
Alexandra Rojas, Executive Director
Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=23&akid=21578%2E1203867%2Ec87YnP) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the [Centers for Disease Control](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=24&akid=21578%2E1203867%2Ec87YnP) and your state public health department.

Derek, Exactly one year ago, we inaugurated President Biden and Vice President Kamala Harris into the White House after four long years of Donald Trump. Thank goodness. Millions of Americans breathed a sigh of relief knowing that dignity, honesty, and respect were restored to the White House. But we also knew that our work wasn’t finished. If anything, it was only beginning. With our new slim Democratic majority, we immediately got to work addressing years of damage caused by Trump and the Republican Party. We needed to act swiftly and decisively to distribute COVID-19 vaccines, take bold action to combat child poverty, and make sure folks didn’t lose their homes during a once-in-a-century economic and public health crisis. And we did exactly that by passing the _American Rescue Plan_ — without a single Republican vote. One of the largest social spending packages since FDR’s New Deal, the _American Rescue Plan_ put $1.9 trillion toward relief for working-class families and individuals, cut child poverty in half, put millions of vaccines into arms, distributed billions of dollars in emergency rental assistance, and did so much more to keep families and small businesses afloat. It brought our country back from the brink of the last winter wave, but we didn’t stop there — Democrats reached across the aisle and brought Congress together to agree to a $1 trillion bipartisan infrastructure bill. Roads and bridges, yes, but also broadband internet, clean drinking water, ports and rivers, and so much more. A historic piece of legislation that Donald Trump couldn’t even pass through his Republican-controlled Senate. But Democrats got it done. And that’s what you helped make happen thanks to your work, your calls, your donations, and your persistence. But we can’t give up now — we need to continue to fight for progress because there’s still so much on the line. Because of the Senate’s obstruction lapsing Child Tax Credit payments, the child poverty rate could increase up to 17 percent this month. We need to protect voting rights. Enact climate solutions. Uphold reproductive rights. Pass universal health care. And protect our democracy. Derek, none of this work is possible without your energy, support, and dedication. And as we progress through 2022, I’m going to be counting on you to help protect and expand our slim Democratic majorities in the House and the Senate. **Right now, can you pitch in $10 or any amount that feels right to you to kickstart our next year fighting for progress? clean_body: | Derek, Exactly one year ago, we inaugurated President Biden and Vice President Kamala Harris into the White House after four long years of Donald Trump. Thank goodness. Millions of Americans breathed a sigh of relief knowing that dignity, honesty, and respect were restored to the White House. But we also knew that our work wasn’t finished. If anything, it was only beginning. With our new slim Democratic majority, we immediately got to work addressing years of damage caused by Trump and the Republican Party. We needed to act swiftly and decisively to distribute COVID-19 vaccines, take bold action to combat child poverty, and make sure folks didn’t lose their homes during a once-in-a-century economic and public health crisis. And we did exactly that by passing the American Rescue Plan — without a single Republican vote. One of the largest social spending packages since FDR’s New Deal, the American Rescue Plan put $1.9 trillion toward relief for working-class families and individuals, cut child poverty in half, put millions of vaccines into arms, distributed billions of dollars in emergency rental assistance, and did so much more to keep families and small businesses afloat. It brought our country back from the brink of the last winter wave, but we didn’t stop there — Democrats reached across the aisle and brought Congress together to agree to a $1 trillion bipartisan infrastructure bill. Roads and bridges, yes, but also broadband internet, clean drinking water, ports and rivers, and so much more. A historic piece of legislation that Donald Trump couldn’t even pass through his Republican-controlled Senate. But Democrats got it done. And that’s what you helped make happen thanks to your work, your calls, your donations, and your persistence. But we can’t give up now — we need to continue to fight for progress because there’s still so much on the line. Because of the Senate’s obstruction lapsing Child Tax Credit payments, the child poverty rate could increase up to 17 percent this month. We need to protect voting rights. Enact climate solutions. Uphold reproductive rights. Pass universal health care. And protect our democracy. Derek, none of this work is possible without your energy, support, and dedication. Friend,
The Founding Fathers never intended for a rule like the filibuster – which mandates a 60-vote threshold for most bills to proceed through the Senate – to restrict our right to vote.
The right to vote is sacred. Our elected officials have a moral responsibility to defend our democracy. Anything less is a betrayal of the voters who put them in office.
**The critically important _Freedom to Vote Act_ and _John Lewis Voting Rights Act_ were filibustered again yesterday,** thanks to certain Senators who chose to preserve the filibuster over passing federal voting protections.
We are facing wave after wave of new voter suppression bills across the country, all at the behest of the GOP and special interests with dark money ties. And it all comes after suffering a vicious, year-long attack against mail-in ballots, drop boxes, voting lines, and more.
**Friend, e veryone’s voice should be heard and every vote should count.**
**In Congress, I will work diligently and urgently to protect our freedom to vote. That is my mission and I won’t rest until it’s done. body:
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001w1VuxxNbckM0sWGBOztCEfER10XMlED7ovzNEYfLOc3ufIxav8J-8_BpsHh51rjppg2ghAyLMY5MJxE_dNPI3HphGwix7CnDMpspAQYtxXwe6EPXeiWUVCU5R5SWghbN_SbxGWRKQdKbKQhDyjtLlYquNAxV0DzlN_YZA-OicguCgrU1xAwTw3-FsJbjmpsAA8pqcZd-9tA=&c=B5j-gLHvUqMJS0xedgJDK1huTC4FhIb4Wh_fJZknJr_BvaDOSe_uEg==&ch=kV741_x0pap76yQldRPC3J4TdiADLU5TZHlH3fKDnz6UUm8BcK3vxA==)
---
| Peter,
Joe Biden is a failure. Thanks to his first year in office, America is mired in malaise at home and humiliation abroad. Inflation is nearly at a 40-year high, gas prices hit a 7-year high and the supply chain crisis is leaving grocery store shelves barren across the country. And those are just the toplines... Our country is experiencing an unprecedented surge of illegal immigration at our southern border thanks to Biden's dangerous open border policies. There are 13 dead American soldiers and still many Americans stranded behind enemy lines thanks to a botched withdrawal from Afghanistan. Violent crime is skyrocketing, with several major cities in America experiencing all-time homicide records thanks to anti-law enforcement policies and Soros-funded prosecutors. Shelves are empty at the grocery store thanks to a self-inflicted supply chain crisis and worker shortage. Biden has continued bending the knee and taking a soft stance against the threat we face from the Chinese Communist Party. After promising to "shut down the virus," COVID cases are at an all-time high nationally. All of this adds up to one of, if not the worst first year of any president in our lifetimes. As a result, America is hurting. We have a weak leader who avoids answering tough, but necessary, questions and frequently calls a lid on the day by lunchtime. But I'm tirelessly working hard in Florida to counter Biden's crises, Peter. I proposed a gas tax holiday to help Floridians who are getting crushed with rising gas prices and inflation. I worked to help alleviate the stress on America's supply chain with Florida's ports that operate 24/7/365. I sent reinforcements to the southern border when Texas asked for help with the migrant surges. I stand shoulder-to-shoulder with Florida's law enforcement and have made it a priority to ensure they are appreciated and empowered to keep our communities safe. And, perhaps most importantly, I REFUSED to let Biden and Fauci make Floridians choose between a jab and their job. Florida has taken on a leadership role and quickly become THE example other states are following. I will continue to lead, and I promise you we will continue to find success despite the shackles of Joe Biden's administration.
Sincerely,
---
|
---
| Ron DeSantis

Growing up, my dad would tell me: _“you need to leave your community a little better than you found it.”_
He was a GM line worker, and he worked tirelessly to provide for his wife and three children. Watching his commitment to caring for our family taught me the value of hard work and grit.
Those values pushed me to work my way through college, build my own business from scratch, and put down roots in Las Vegas where I raised my two girls as a single dad.
Those values also served as the foundation of my campaign when I ran for Governor in 2018.
I took that determination and grit and focused on what Nevadans are relying on their leaders to do – **building an economy that supports working families, giving frontline workers the recognition and protection they deserve, and investing in Nevada’s public schools while uplifting our hardworking educators.**

clean_body: | | | | | Folks, My name is Steve Sisolak. I’m a Democratic Governor running for reelection to keep Battleground Nevada blue. I want to tell you a little bit about my values and why I’m in this fight, but first, | | | Growing up, my dad would tell me: “you need to leave your community a little better than you found it.” He was a GM line worker, and he worked tirelessly to provide for his wife and three children. Watching his commitment to caring for our family taught me the value of hard work and grit. Those values pushed me to work my way through college, build my own business from scratch, and put down roots in Las Vegas where I raised my two girls as a single dad. Those values also served as the foundation of my campaign when I ran for Governor in 2018. I took that determination and grit and focused on what Nevadans are relying on their leaders to do – building an economy that supports working families, giving frontline workers the recognition and protection they deserve, and investing in Nevada’s public schools while uplifting our hardworking educators. Looking back, there’s no doubt that we’ve made huge strides in creating a stronger, healthier, and more equitable Nevada. But the work isn’t done yet. Leaving Nevada better than we found it will take bringing thousands of people together to join the fight to keep Nevada moving forward. | Peter,
Joe Biden is a failure. Thanks to his first year in office, America is mired in malaise at home and humiliation abroad. Inflation is nearly at a 40-year high, gas prices hit a 7-year high and the supply chain crisis is leaving grocery store shelves barren across the country. And those are just the toplines... Our country is experiencing an unprecedented surge of illegal immigration at our southern border thanks to Biden's dangerous open border policies. There are 13 dead American soldiers and still many Americans stranded behind enemy lines thanks to a botched withdrawal from Afghanistan. Violent crime is skyrocketing, with several major cities in America experiencing all-time homicide records thanks to anti-law enforcement policies and Soros-funded prosecutors. Shelves are empty at the grocery store thanks to a self-inflicted supply chain crisis and worker shortage. Biden has continued bending the knee and taking a soft stance against the threat we face from the Chinese Communist Party. After promising to "shut down the virus," COVID cases are at an all-time high nationally. All of this adds up to one of, if not the worst first year of any president in our lifetimes. As a result, America is hurting. We have a weak leader who avoids answering tough, but necessary, questions and frequently calls a lid on the day by lunchtime. But I'm tirelessly working hard in Florida to counter Biden's crises, Peter. I proposed a gas tax holiday to help Floridians who are getting crushed with rising gas prices and inflation. I worked to help alleviate the stress on America's supply chain with Florida's ports that operate 24/7/365. I sent reinforcements to the southern border when Texas asked for help with the migrant surges. I stand shoulder-to-shoulder with Florida's law enforcement and have made it a priority to ensure they are appreciated and empowered to keep our communities safe. And, perhaps most importantly, I REFUSED to let Biden and Fauci make Floridians choose between a jab and their job. Florida has taken on a leadership role and quickly become THE example other states are following. I will continue to lead, and I promise you we will continue to find success despite the shackles of Joe Biden's administration.
Sincerely,

body:
He's a Democrat with an R next to his name. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/neilforarkansas/jan6-5066089?e=eda539b26b)
---
| | [ ](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=887b71e39b&e=eda539b26b)
---
| | Fellow Patriot:

On January 6, peaceful Trump supporters gathered to hear the President speak. Some of these Trump supporters eventually made their way to the Capitol, where they protested the brazen **_THEFT_** of the 2020 “election,” the greatest fraud ever perpetrated against our nation.

At the Capitol, undercover FBI agents and informants incited a riot. Capitol Police officers let Trump supporters into the building and then acted as if they had broken in.

For the crime of being a Trump supporter and protesting the illegal Democrat _**COUP**_ , Air Force veteran Ashli Babbitt— _an unarmed woman_ —was assassinated in cold blood. Her killer is celebrated as a hero by Democrats and RINOs alike.

Ashli wasn’t the only Trump supporter murdered that day—video has emerged of the Capitol Police killing another woman, Roseanne Boyland, apparently _beating her to death_. The Capitol Police is also responsible for the brutal deaths of other Trump supporters that day, like Kevin Greeson.

Before January 6th, my worthless traitor opponent, Deep State Steve Womack, announced that he would certify the fraudulent “election” results, falsely claiming that President Trump’s election fraud lawsuits had been “soundly defeated.” Swamp Scum Steve declared that we have to “accept the results.”

After the Fed-incited riot at the Capitol, Deep State Steve fully blamed President Trump for the chaos, calling it a “deadly attack.” He accused the President of making a “locker room speech” to get his supporters “stoked up” to storm the Capitol.

Womack belittled Trump supporters—his own constituents—as “extremists,” and referred to claims of election fraud as “a whole lot of promises and expectations that just simply were not true,” ignoring the overwhelming evidence that the 2020 election was stolen.

**Deep State Steve called President Trump “somebody who basically doesn’t have regard for the Constitution, or the rule of law, where it comes to protecting [his] grip on power.”**

Womack went on the local news and bloviated that “this is not who we are,” _sounding more like Michelle Obama than a conservative Arkansan._

He wouldn’t stop smearing the Trump supporters protesting the 2020 Coup, calling them “just as un-American and unpatriotic as anything I've ever seen.”

**Who does Steve represent? It certainly isn’t us.**

He called my good friend Richard “Bigo” Barnett, one of his very own constituents, whom you know as the legend who kicked back at Pelosi’s ill-gotten desk, a “sickening embarrassment,” adding that he “must be held accountable and face the fullest extent of the law.”

Where was Womack as the blood drained from Ashli Babbitt and Roseanne Boyland’s bodies? He was rewarding the demonic Capitol Police with more funding, calling these cold-blooded killers “brave.”

Where was Womack as Trump supporters from grandmothers to disabled veterans were rounded up and tossed into the DC Gulag, where they are _still _being held in solitary confinement and _tortured_?

Take Ryan Samsel, for instance.

_Sadistic_ prison guards came into Ryan’s cell one night, zip-tied his hands behind his back so tightly that they _took the skin off_ of his wrists, _threw _him to the concrete floor and _beat his face_ _in_. His right eye was damaged so severely that it’s _permanently blinded_. His nose and jaw were broken, and he will suffer seizures for the rest of his life.

Remember: Antifa and BLM looted, burned, raped, and murdered across _dozens_ of cities last summer, and _not a single person was ever punished_.

Now, rather than fight for the January 6th Patriots’ civil rights, Deep State Steve voted with _Nancy Pelosi_ to create a 9/11-style commission to serve the Democrats’ _witch hunt_ and perpetuate their “insurrection” _hoax_ , _legitimizing _the treatment of Trump supporters as terrorists.

**RINOs like him will happily toss us in gulags and throw away the keys. It’s _us_ against _them_ , and he’s with _them_.**

Steve Womack called January 6th a “national embarrassment.”

**The only national embarrassment I see is the treason of a so-called Republican Congressman aiding and abetting a criminal coup, facilitating the Democrats’ theft of the United States Government.

The only national embarrassment I see is the pure evil of a so-called Republican Congressman willfully turning a blind eye to the torture and murder of innocent Trump supporters in our nation’s capital.**

_**Deep State Steve is the real national embarrassment. He is a disgrace to the Constitution, to America, and to Arkansas.**_

**[_Punish him by __electing_ _ me.

Send this vile traitor packing and elect a real Fighter who will NEVER turn his back on you_](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=5c33534cde&e=eda539b26b)****.**

[**_Help me send Deep __State_ _ Steve a message that his time is UP -- Chip into my election campaign right away and show them the power of the America First movement_**](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=daa89d7e92&e=eda539b26b) _._

_We need PATRIOTS who will**STOP** the politicized Regime DOJ from persecuting and ruining the lives of conservative Americans, not Wishy-Washy Wimps like Womack._

[_**Your contributions to my campaign will help me purchase TV and radio ads, yard signs, and other campaign materials so I can fight the worthless GOP, retire a weak RINO, and replace him with a fierce America First Warrior**_.](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=5ab3969e3d&e=eda539b26b)

Thank you in advance for your generous support. For America,
Neil Robinson Kumar
_Republican for U.S. Congress, AR-03_

**P.S. The Republican Party of Arkansas is pulling out all the stops to kill my authentic America First campaign. ** [_**I know you're ready to replace these worthless RINOs with America First conservatives like me, and that's why I'm counting on your contribution of $5, $10, $25, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more today**_](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=00794f4c2b&e=eda539b26b)** _._**

body:
| Peter -- There’s something very important that conservative Minnesotans need to understand: _If we choose the same failed career politicians to face off against Walz this November, we will lose to the radical left **AGAIN**._ The left has grown far too comfortable in this state, challenged only by weak Republicans that resort to abandoning their principles to get elected. In a desperate attempt to hold onto their positions, they govern so timidly that most of the time you can’t even tell they’re Republicans! **Conservatives cannot afford to make these same mistakes any longer.** I am running to kick the radical leftists and career politicians out of their ivory tower, and fight hard to take back the liberties they have stolen from us. This movement to save our state will not be successful without your help. If you value liberty, if you’re sick of what Tim Walz and Joe Biden have done to Minnesota and this great country, then I need you to go to caucus on February 1st. **Going to caucus, signing up to be a delegate, and voting to endorse our campaign for a free Minnesota is the single most important thing we can do to get a CONSERVATIVE in the governor’s office next year, and take back our state!** If grassroots conservatives don’t take action Right Now, Tyrant Tim Walz will glide into a second term and continue destroying the state we want to keep calling home. | [](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=iUaD1gacZHU3dYzSqkV0rDtEWI05k2OFQpzb7QbZ3ic&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=caucus_push_1_fixed_link&n=1 "Go To Caucus - Be A Delegate") [Go To Caucus - Be A Delegate](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=iUaD1gacZHU3dYzSqkV0rDtEWI05k2OFQpzb7QbZ3ic&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=caucus_push_1_fixed_link&n=1)

body:
WE NEED YOUR HELP
Dear Friend,
Did you know that Maggie Hassan sold her vote to the radical left to abandon the filibuster?

Hassan pivots to the left in order to eliminate the filibuster and rush a vote in the Senate to federalize elections and take away New Hampshire’s rights to conduct their own elections.

Hassan and the radical left want the federal government to mandate early voting and no-excuse absentee ballots and impose federal rules on voter ID requirements that would override state laws. Essentially [ELIMINATING](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fnew-hampshire-gop%2Fdefeat-hassan/1/0100017e78f77ebe-0ee82694-314c-447f-9360-ccd71f7e3c94-000000/X4RyL4hEDopBHDT3cL0wTQAdN1M=254) individual state rights on elections.

name: Charles Booker
subject: Mitch saying the quiet part out loud
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter, please
understand one thing:

Being Black doesn’t make you less of an American, no matter what this
craven man thinks.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220120?refcode=em20220120-1470&t=1001&refcode2=1470_346206_C9eSvZ&akid=1470%2E346206%2EC9eSvZ ]Mitch McConnell says Black people vote just as much as 'Americans'

Mitch really said: “If you look at the statistics, African-American voters
are voting in just as high a percentage as Americans.”

To which I say, Mitch: Black Americans are American. And I am no less
American than you.

And though Mitch McConnell may be stuck thinking I'm three-fifths of a
person — he's gonna have to acknowledge me as a whole Senator when we beat
Rand Paul this year.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220120?refcode=em20220120-1470&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&refcode2=1470_346206_C9eSvZ&akid=1470%2E346206%2EC9eSvZ ]Peter, we
deserve so much better than Mitch McConnell and Rand Paul representing us
in Washington. I’m ready to step up and serve the people of Kentucky in
the U.S. Senate, but I can’t do it without your help. Can you chip in
$5 to send me to the Senate? »

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220120?refcode=em20220120-1470&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&refcode2=1470_346206_C9eSvZ&akid=1470%2E346206%2EC9eSvZ ]Contribute $5

This foul comment came out of Mitch McConnell’s mouth not even a day after
all 50 Senate Republicans voted to protect the Jim Crow filibuster,
effectively blocking the voting rights legislation that’s been sitting in
the Senate for months.

Mitch never cared about the filibuster when he packed the Supreme Court.
His doom and gloom talk about protecting the filibuster at the expense of
our voting rights — more specifically, at the expense of the voting rights
of Black and brown Americans — is a shameful lie.

Mitch has never cared about us. And today, he just happened to speak his
mind, and said the quiet part out loud. All the while, Rand Paul continues
to idly stand by and join him in obstructing our democracy.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220120?refcode=em20220120-1470&t=1023&refcode2=1470_346206_C9eSvZ&akid=1470%2E346206%2EC9eSvZ ]Enough. Kentucky deserves better than this — and I’m proud to be
running to represent you and every American in the Senate. Please, chip in
$5 to spread our message and fuel our grassroots movement
to end this chapter of failed leadership in Kentucky.

Together,

Charles Booker

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:

#
Derek,
We have just a few hours left in our 24-hour flash fundraising goal. We need 801 more donors to chip in right now if we’re going to meet this goal and demonstrate the power of our grassroots movement. **[Can you be one of them?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/41019?refcode=ema20220120-4271&t=1&akid=4271%2E434096%2EKXjK11)**

John, Gisele, and our whole team believe in the power of our grassroots donors. We know with you and the rest of our supporters, we can win our primary and win on Election Day. We just need to prove it to everyone else.

Peter,
---
My story is the American story.
---
I’m a first-generation immigrant. I came to this country with my parents as a young boy, and through hard work and faith I was fortunate enough to live the American dream.
---
_This country has given me everything._ That’s why I couldn’t sit on the sidelines while Biden, Pelosi, and the rest of the liberal gang lead our country down a reckless and dangerous path.
---
We MUST change direction in Washington, or our children and grandchildren won’t have the same opportunity to rise the way you and I did.

I was the first from my family to achieve a higher education, and I paid for it by working several jobs and earning scholarships.
---
Sadly, many politicians on the Left no longer believe in that kind of hard work and sacrifice. They believe in socialism, government handouts, and the welfare state.
---

---

clean_body: I believe in America. | Peter, My story is the American story. I’m a first-generation immigrant. I came to this country with my parents as a young boy, and through hard work and faith I was fortunate enough to live the American dream. This country has given me everything. That’s why I couldn’t sit on the sidelines while Biden, Pelosi, and the rest of the liberal gang lead our country down a reckless and dangerous path. We MUST change direction in Washington, or our children and grandchildren won’t have the same opportunity to rise the way you and I did. I grew up in a working-class family, Peter. My parents instilled conservative values, a strong work ethic, and an optimistic can-do attitude in my siblings and I from a young age. I was the first from my family to achieve a higher education, and I paid for it by working several jobs and earning scholarships. Sadly, many politicians on the Left no longer believe in that kind of hard work and sacrifice. They believe in socialism, government handouts, and the welfare state. We’ve seen what that looks like. Just look at California and their sky-high taxes, crushing regulations, socialist wealth redistribution, and out-of-control spending. We can’t let Biden and Pelosi take all of America down that same failed path. It’s time for a change in our nation’s capital. It’s time to elect leaders who understand what makes our country great – and who are ready to fight to defend it. It’s time to save the American dream before it’s lost forever. Hi Peter, I've just published a new blog post: [The Year of Accountability](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQziorqDrTPVcPjB6ZRPVGrbfpntJ4-dllSZbkJoqrUFxLIow&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_jan_20&n=1) Voting is underway in the Recall of three SF board members who refused to open schools. 2022 is the year of accountability. Even San Francisco’s liberal Mayor and Senator support the Recall. Throughout California, I’ve met many lifelong Democrats who are voting differently this year. Some things, it turns out, go beyond partisanship – sanity, decency, and respect. 2022 also offers a chance for the ultimate measure of accountability in education: putting funding in the hands of parents. You can access the petition for the School Choice ballot proposition [here](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=r3SH3GtJzOIUFreKjpahcqv-3aVyqrBjrZQDoJhpMde7zqYqs5o-6pN0UraZteuk&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_jan_20&n=2). Fighting for accountability is how I see my job in the Legislature. We just won a small victory when we got the “Superintendent of Equity” to resign his $180,000 post, after I pointed out his hiring was illegal. And it's how I'll see my job in Congress. For instance, we’ve now learned Biden's Administration was behind the outrageous letter calling parents “domestic terrorists” for speaking up at school board meetings. The fact no one has resigned shows how badly accountability is needed. [Help me bring accountability to the Biden Aministration](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G0iUqqLQazIF6cOfkGWrQv5&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_jan_20&n=3) Kevin Kiley

body:
Let’s take a look back at some highlights from Alex’s first year in the Senate.
#

Friends -
It’s been exactly one year since Alex was sworn in to the United States Senate. While there’s still plenty of work to do (like passing legislation to protect voting rights), we wanted to take a look back at some highlights from Alex’s first year in the Senate.
**_January_**
One year ago today, on January 20, 2021, Alex attended the inauguration for President Biden and Vice President Harris, and then was sworn in to the U.S. Senate alongside Senators Warnock and Ossoff.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-jan22?refcode=em220120-1-15&t=1&refcode2=588_159979_cJLubo&akid=588%2E159979%2EcJLubo)
**_February_**
Then, in February, Alex was outspoken on the need to hold Trump accountable and cast his vote to impeach Trump.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-jan22?refcode=em220120-1-15&t=2&refcode2=588_159979_cJLubo&akid=588%2E159979%2EcJLubo)
**_March_**
In March, Alex worked with his Senate colleagues to pass the American Rescue Plan — one of the most consequential pieces of legislation in our lifetime — a major Covid-19 relief bill that included direct financial aid to families struggling to make ends meet, funding for vaccines and testing, and support for small businesses, state and local governments.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-jan22?refcode=em220120-1-15&t=3&refcode2=588_159979_cJLubo&akid=588%2E159979%2EcJLubo)
**_April_**
In April, Alex joined Sen. Ed Markey and Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez to reintroduce the Green New Deal. Alex is a co-sponsor on the bill.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-jan22?refcode=em220120-1-15&t=4&refcode2=588_159979_cJLubo&akid=588%2E159979%2EcJLubo)
**_May_**
In May, Alex got to see L.A.’s first electrified school bus — where he also introduced the _Clean Commute for Kids Act_ , which provides funding to replace diesel school buses with electric ones nationwide and will reduce exposure to harmful air pollution for the 25 million children that ride school buses.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-jan22?refcode=em220120-1-15&t=5&refcode2=588_159979_cJLubo&akid=588%2E159979%2EcJLubo)
**_June_**
In June, Alex traveled across California to highlight President Biden’s infrastructure plan and how it would bring billions of dollars and thousands of jobs to California.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-jan22?refcode=em220120-1-15&t=6&refcode2=588_159979_cJLubo&akid=588%2E159979%2EcJLubo)
**_July_**
In July, Alex attended a naturalization ceremony in San Pedro. Among the 50 becoming U.S. citizens were people from Guatemala, Norway, China, Nigeria, Mexico, the Philippines, Canada, Thailand, Vietnam and South Korea.
He presented the keynote address at the ceremony and talked about how his own parents were immigrants to the United States from Mexico.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-jan22?refcode=em220120-1-15&t=7&refcode2=588_159979_cJLubo&akid=588%2E159979%2EcJLubo)
**_August_**
Then in August, Alex led the 25th annual Lake Tahoe Summit. As the host of the summit, Alex called for ambitious national action to combat the climate crisis, in addition to renewed environmental protection efforts at Lake Tahoe.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-jan22?refcode=em220120-1-15&t=8&refcode2=588_159979_cJLubo&akid=588%2E159979%2EcJLubo)
**_September_**
The right-wing Republican Recall of Governor Newsom posed a real threat to all the progress we’ve made here in California. But in September, we defeated the recall attempt and kept Governor Newsom in office.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-jan22?refcode=em220120-1-15&t=9&refcode2=588_159979_cJLubo&akid=588%2E159979%2EcJLubo)
**_October_**
In October, after an oil spill off the coast of Orange County, Alex was on the ground to survey the damage and push for the passage of the _West Coast Ocean Protection Act_ , legislation he co-sponsored with Sen. Feinstein to ban offshore oil drilling in California.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-jan22?refcode=em220120-1-15&t=10&refcode2=588_159979_cJLubo&akid=588%2E159979%2EcJLubo)
**_November_**
In November, President Biden signed the _Infrastructure and Investment Jobs Act_ , delivering long overdue, historic investments to rebuild America’s infrastructure and public transit, while creating millions of good-paying, union jobs.
It was particularly exciting because the package included some of the very first bills Alex worked on as a Senator, including legislation to shore up California’s water resources, electrify school buses around the country, and improve the resilience of our electrical grid.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-jan22?refcode=em220120-1-15&t=11&refcode2=588_159979_cJLubo&akid=588%2E159979%2EcJLubo)
**_December_**
Then in December, the Senate confirmed the nomination of Judge Lucy Koh to the Ninth Circuit — making her the first Korean American to serve on a federal circuit court.
Alex introduced Judge Koh during her confirmation hearing, and worked closely with the Biden administration in advising and supporting her nomination in effort to help rebuild the federal judiciary to better reflect the America it serves.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-jan22?refcode=em220120-1-15&t=12&refcode2=588_159979_cJLubo&akid=588%2E159979%2EcJLubo)
Thank you for sticking with us this year — and for sticking with us to the bottom of this email! It’s been an incredible first year in the Senate, but there is still so much to do.
From protecting the right to vote, to immigration reform, to guaranteeing health care as a right for everyone, to passing a Green New Deal, our work is far from over.
Thank you for being a part of it.
All the best,
Team Padilla
**[DONATE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-jan22?refcode=em220120-1-15&t=13&refcode2=588_159979_cJLubo&akid=588%2E159979%2EcJLubo)**

Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can [ unsubscribe here.](https://act.alex-padilla.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=14&akid=588%2E159979%2EcJLubo)

**If we are going to flip the 5th, we need all hands on deck.** Whether you can [contribute to the campaign](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=a6b911ac9b&e=356c0699dd),[ sign up to volunteer](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=ce4449e761&e=356c0699dd), or simply [list yourself as a public supporter on my website](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=6a402d8447&e=356c0699dd), truly anything helps.

| The odds may be against us, but I won’t let that stop me from advocating for the hard working Wisconsinites like you who just want our government to work again for everyday Americans — and for our democracy to survive for our children and grandchildren.

Together we can ensure every American family has a chance at the American dream.

Thanks a bunch,

Mike

| Date: 1/19/22

Hi there,

Over the last few weeks I rolled out my common-sense plan to restore our Democracy — and while I am optimistic that this living, breathing plan will make significant improvements in our state. We won’t Flip the 5th to realize these improvements without your support.

If we are going to ban voter suppression laws, promote voting, end gerrymandering, reduce big-money influence, or ensure election integrity to any degree, we need all hands on deck to defeat Scott Fitzgerald first. His only interest is in keeping his seat, not in being accountable to us.

**Simply put: I need you on my team to share my plan and vision for our state.[Are you able to help us reach more people by making a contribution of $100, $50, or even $20 today? ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=3af3b26bcd&e=356c0699dd)**

---
| Wisconsinites deserve better than the hand we’ve been dealt, but we won’t make it out of Fitzgerald’s stronghold if we don’t work together. [Please, if you are able, consider a contribution to help fuel our voter outreach program today.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=a4bf597999&e=356c0699dd)

The truth is, our democracy needs constant maintenance, like a car, a furnace, or a human relationship. It’s not “set it and forget it.” We must take care to ensure it survives for the long term.

But if we work together, if we agree on the basics — that our nation relies on the consent of the governed and our leaders answer to the voters, we will be in much, much better shape.

Thank you,

Mike

Washington failed us last night.
#

Friends -
Washington failed us last night.
The Senate put the Freedom to Vote Act up for a vote, and when Republicans blocked it, two Democratic senators lacked the courage necessary to protect our constitutional rights and democracy.
It is once again clear that a 50-50 seat tie is not enough. Democrats need to expand our majority with two Senators who understand the stakes of this fight and who are unafraid to act — even if that means ending the filibuster.
Val Demings and I can win and deliver those two seats. You can count on us to deliver for our families, but we need your support.
