That just doesn’t fly. In Congress, our mandate from the American people is simple: Don’t do anything dumb. Democrats haven’t gotten the memo.

**Democrats have the narrowest congressional majority in the last 50 years, yet they’re acting as if they have a supermajority**.

Clearly Pelosi, Schumer, and Biden don’t remember what happened in 2010 after they went rogue and passed Obamacare without a single Republican vote. Need a reminder? **Republicans picked up 63 seats in the House and flipped the majority.**

Democrats are at it once again. They’ve added more than $2 trillion to our national debt in just twelve months and they’re eyeing an additional $3 trillion in spending in the coming months - with zero plans to negotiate with Republicans.

Without control of the House or the Senate, Republicans are inherently at a disadvantage. Right now, we can’t block Democrats’ pet projects from making their way into COVID relief legislation or stop Biden from halting construction on the Keystone Pipeline.

| | Friend,

If a football team lost a game by 16 points, most fans would say the winning team played better, or that their own losing team needed to regroup, retrain, and rethink a winning strategy. It's doubtful that even the most disappointed fans would claim the game was stolen by the winners.

So it's time to move on from the fact that Donald Trump lost to Joe Biden by 16 points in Oregon. It's time for disappointed Oregon Republicans to focus on the 2022 elections. It's time to look ahead.

Make no mistake, we have plenty of work ahead in order to restore faith in our election systems. As governor, I will lead the charge for frequent election audits by an objective, independent entity. I will also fight to outlaw ballot harvesting, which allows third parties to handle or collect other peoples' ballots. But our very own Republican former Secretary of State Dennis Richardson conducted a thorough audit and found no evidence of election fraud in Oregon. I urge you, if you have doubts about our system, do what I have done: visit your county elections office and witness the process yourself.

After losses in both the 2010 Rose Bowl and the 2011 BCS National Championship, the Ducks went on to victory in the 2012 Rose Bowl and the 2013 Fiesta Bowl. They regrouped and developed a winning strategy. It's time we regroup as a party and look ahead to the 2022 election, which is the greatest opportunity we've had in decades to elect a Republican governor and restore balance to state government.

It's time for us to finally score a touchdown, and I'm focused on a forward-thinking strategy that can get us there.

I'm ready to make some changes. [](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=3fcb452ec5b84111b419c69f3fa50201&_m=35f7818afe2141888a54139b96ad0365&_e=axuvI9vahImTmWVN4W5Dnd_Sy5HlvjUzaw5pyPt_9EJpESEMGUFP9V9DYcSQBzJmJ_hkg5vnl30MC20wdrPKMWk5gogjtMP6FK-W3AWQGKYcN9lYrgpiA-1hJpc-8zdyF5yrE10o98mc0P--FcJoExLdxEmJ0IvMT2pJDzgm0wSYLvmq_bEkTky-NC1rJOYE_JkvUw5EL6jUVVlH9PBd-LwUrZjlDS2m-Z5Jkn1Y20ukVQxvLkTZxbZ6LEsl7HijTHa6sdyEJzLdK7u4kd3I7h0nxn8JisCHx-go-uZQnV3CXyR1C2tBZNpmr-s9v7jvSPRlpiN5uPlqhmJqGUxAZg%3D%3D) My friend,
Did you know that Minnesota is one of 12 states that taxes Social Security checks? For folks who are receiving Social Security, every penny counts, especially with Bidenflation devouring consumer's purchasing power. Nine in 10 individuals age 65 and older receive Social Security benefits. Seniors rely on Social Security to make ends meet. According to the Social Security Association, 37% of men and 42% of women receive 50% or more of their income from Social Security. **So why are we taxing them?** A simple, common-sense measure that I will take as your governor will be to ensure that when it comes time to receive Social Security benefits, Minnesotans get ALL of the benefits they worked hard for. # 400 signatures in 24 hours

Jewel-Osco means a lot to me. When Pops ran for Alderman we stood out in the parking lot to collect signatures. I was maybe eleven years old. Just seeing my Pops trying to get those signatures made me believe it was possible for myself. Twenty-five years later I’m going to be in the Jewel parking lot doing the same thing.

**Meet me at the Jewel parking lot off 87th street this Saturday at 10am for my Sign-a-Thon.** I’m running for US Congress in the 1st District and I need 400 signatures to get on the ballot. **My challenge is to surpass 400 signatures within 24 hours.** I’ll be out there all day and pitch a tent if I have to. Stop by to sign my petition this Saturday.

If you can join me, sign up [here](https://cole2022.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7401cdbeeb0470d9b36be09ed&id=0a4582e284&e=339f142c50)!
As we move forward, hire new members of the team, and build out more programming, I could use your support. **If you can make a contribution, whatever it may be, it would mean so much to this campaign.** **Please consider making a contribution using this**[link](https://cole2022.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7401cdbeeb0470d9b36be09ed&id=22b3b3b8f2&e=339f142c50).
**Thank you for your support.**

Yours in service,
Jahmal

---
| | |
---
We just kicked off our volunteer programming to collect signatures and get us on the ballot. And I am so optimistic! In the face of so much adversity, we have gotten to this point, and I am proud of what we’ve done so far. Recently, **Bishop Trotter told me: “If God has his hands on this race, it doesn’t matter who jumps in.”** I needed that reminder because the next six months are going to be a lot of work. **Thank you to everyone who showed up!**

name: Tom Norton
subject: big news
body:
Dear Patriot,

I’m proud to be a lifelong West Michigan resident, Afghan War Veteran, husband, father, and candidate for Congress here in the new 2nd Congressional District.

This is where I’ve chosen to raise my children, and where I’d like them to be able to choose to raise theirs. Other than my time in the military, western Michigan has always been my home.

Until recently, I was running for Congress against Peter Meijer, a man we trusted to represent us in Congress and who began to betray us from the moment he got to DC, starting with his vote to impeach President Trump.

However, the redistricting commission has radically changed the lines of the map, moving Peter Meijer out of my home district and expanding it to be more rural and much more Conservative.

Will you help me make sure that we have a strong conservative representative that shares the values of this district? Please contribute today at https://contacts.tom.gop//l/Oxl6a1Fvy59S6763vIEQrTBw/g763heo4kAS1ALNv763JqOTDPQ/lJJCi7633DOrgmqsc4LDPK1w.

While the district has changed, my goal remains the same: to ensure that the person we send to represent us in Washington brings our values and our interests to DC.

What does that mean?

It means on my first day in office, I will introduce legislation to audit the 2020 general election, which I believe was rigged, and give all of the allegations a chance to be examined in front of the nation. And it means ensuring election integrity moving forward by requiring real, government issued ID to vote.

It means opposing all government and private vaccine and mask mandates and restoring medical privacy to ensure nobody in this country needs to choose between their job and the jab.

It means securing our border from illegal immigration, an immigration moratorium, a freeze on Afghanistan refugee resettlement, and enacting strict limits on the worker visas that allow foreign corporations to import cheap technical labor that undercuts American wages and drives up the cost of housing. And it means requiring E-Verify for all employers.

It means banning biological men from competing in women’s and girls’ sports, and protecting safe spaces for women like bathrooms, locker rooms, and shelters from invasion by men. And it means the government will no longer fund sex change operations.

It means opposing involvement in stupid foreign conflicts that serve no national interest and enrich the military industrial complex at the cost of the lives of our best and bravest.

It means standing up for the right to life for the unborn and defending our second amendment rights.
And it also means making sure we get Donald Trump back in the White House and continue his agenda of Making America Great Again.

Will you help me win by contributing to my campaign today at https://contacts.tom.gop//l/Oxl6a1Fvy59S6763vIEQrTBw/g763heo4kAS1ALNv763JqOTDPQ/lJJCi7633DOrgmqsc4LDPK1w?

These are the values that I grew up with and that we share. They’re also the values that America needs most right now.

Thank you for your support.

Respectfully,

Tom Norton

PS – Help me win this election to make sure that this solid Republican district is represented by an America First conservative who will not betray our values. Please donate at https://contacts.tom.gop//l/Oxl6a1Fvy59S6763vIEQrTBw/g763heo4kAS1ALNv763JqOTDPQ/lJJCi7633DOrgmqsc4LDPK1w.

With the help of well-known Democrats like President Obama, **our opponent is raising more than $100,000 per day!**

With the highest inflation in 40 years from massive increases in the price of gas, food and rent, families are struggling to make ends meet. Ally Isom moderated a session with blockchain expert Michelle Tsng, Carl Youngblood, and others to discuss [DAO](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0011K4hH-ZSvLZ1EygvGp5WFvzI2ZJo2tuyVBpPwKqCVC_q7RwnTHIWcydhL3oNOsvJQ-o7coqziOVN1RLnjE5gUWHS5NRGZjyApmBCsoOvLQGh15AhSxi6Cvf4pMKpxjGprBT44do1JGIdcTaYB_1I7JdxfSfvBnkq9ZLxU_fZWQdOU7mcUh0JRw==&c=yJ_SCQI0AY6qWkSEfYu4VhJI2175uJa6aS7dHjqK_K3WfwbUo23byg==&ch=Zih3HCa041OuzvoWfsBRkd6yRuFTR-N6VjjRi2fT9GOwowIBEJs5Gw==)s.
"I was honored to participate and excited to be at [Cryptopia](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0011K4hH-ZSvLZ1EygvGp5WFvzI2ZJo2tuyVBpPwKqCVC_q7RwnTHIWcydhL3oNOsvJu88rJjQGBY1ApSCqQ6qNEiklwJ9QVkRNUNoxSe3bLvZgvlSwL4fZA_5HcYLjUwPHPPHusAeP5goPnKdlkNDA-w==&c=yJ_SCQI0AY6qWkSEfYu4VhJI2175uJa6aS7dHjqK_K3WfwbUo23byg==&ch=Zih3HCa041OuzvoWfsBRkd6yRuFTR-N6VjjRi2fT9GOwowIBEJs5Gw==) today," Isom said. "Cryptocurrency and blockchain tech is more relevant than ever - for everyday Utahns and businesses alike. Web3 is here, so let's come together to talk about it and move forward in the best ways possible, understanding both risk and opportunity. It's a big, broad, rich and exciting landscape, and here again, Utah can lead out."
The Ally For Utah campaign now accepts donations in Bitcoin.

|
---
| Walk-A-Mile Tour update Making good on her promise to walk a mile in every Utah community, Ally recently visited Hildale, Apple Valley, and Santa Clara. The picture above was taken in the charming small town of[ Apple Valley, UT](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0011K4hH-ZSvLZ1EygvGp5WFvzI2ZJo2tuyVBpPwKqCVC_q7RwnTHIWcydhL3oNOsvJ6Lech_HwAGRkoa3rnUL5s26hBV6BCzQBKKW8drhH4nbb7jeXyF6fcS0aBm1MFfOhHBKQsUSItnP1vhou_yjUCunjIvEbwgYrl08OLY_3d2Y=&c=yJ_SCQI0AY6qWkSEfYu4VhJI2175uJa6aS7dHjqK_K3WfwbUo23byg==&ch=Zih3HCa041OuzvoWfsBRkd6yRuFTR-N6VjjRi2fT9GOwowIBEJs5Gw==). While walking around with Mayor Mason Walters, Ally appreciated the mayor's candor about the importance of elected officials representing the will of residents and what that stewardship means.
For more information about Ally's walk-a-mile tour, or to see all the Utah communities Ally has visited so far, please visit [allyforutah.com/walkamile/](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0011K4hH-ZSvLZ1EygvGp5WFvzI2ZJo2tuyVBpPwKqCVC_q7RwnTHIWc20o_FcWYgpo_Q8frzzwjGlweKU745qFtOq-SSMOQUjoO4aL-nqFL9Rx0K_bG5Ptj6jyj2aPcmPT4WZvofYEkDBh2IzSC8L6NyGucHVFC64M&c=yJ_SCQI0AY6qWkSEfYu4VhJI2175uJa6aS7dHjqK_K3WfwbUo23byg==&ch=Zih3HCa041OuzvoWfsBRkd6yRuFTR-N6VjjRi2fT9GOwowIBEJs5Gw==). clean_body: We can stop corrupt politicians on both sides of the aisle from getting rich while in office. | | | Something good actually happened in Congress, Friend. Senators Jon Ossoff and Mark Kelly introduced the “Ban Congressional Stock Trading Act” – which would ban members of Congress from enriching themselves based on insider knowledge about individual stocks. One thing we all need to agree on is that it shouldn’t matter what side of the aisle you’re on: no one should make millions of dollars trading on the secrets of government policy in the stock market. It’s corruption in its finest form. The support for this legislation is strong – 75% of voters across all political ideologies agree we need it. But as you know, Congress won’t get anything done unless people like us hold them to it. I remember when elected leaders practiced a clean brand of politics – where candidates ran on building trust and loyalty with their voters. But the corrupt forces running this game have betrayed our trust for too long. One of the biggest culprits of the dirty insider stock trading we see in Washington is our opponent, Ryan Zinke. When he served in the Trump Administration, he failed to disclose his stock holdings in a gun and rifle company that does business with the federal government and ultimately had to resign for his corruption. That’s just one example that we know about. Frankly, Ryan Zinke should be ashamed. And Zinke recently reported more than $32 million in stocks and assets – so there’s no telling how he’d use government secrets for his own personal gain if he makes it to Washington again. Unless we make Congress put a stop to its own individual stock trading. Congress sets the rules for American companies, so allowing them to trade individual stocks leaves the door wide open for immense amounts of corruption. Let’s clean it up.
